title.ja: スクリーンリーダーで数字を使い努力度を選べる
title.ko: 스크린 리더에서 숫자로 노력 수준을 고른다

body.zh-TW: 使用螢幕閱讀器調整 `/effort` 時，選擇器現在會呈現成編號清單，並要求輸入對應數字。螢幕閱讀器（screen reader，把畫面內容讀出聲的輔助工具）需要能循序讀懂每個操作選項與目前選擇。⟦像語音點餐不必在看不見的按鈕間猜位置，只要聽完菜單後說出菜號。⟧ 此外，提示文字和對話框文字不再被裁切，讀到的內容能完整保留。
body.zh-CN: 使用屏幕阅读器调整 `/effort` 时，选择器现在会呈现成编号清单，并要求输入对应数字。屏幕阅读器（screen reader，把画面内容读出声的辅助工具）需要能按顺序读懂选项。⟦像语音点餐不用在看不见的按钮间猜位置，只要听完菜单后说出菜号。⟧ 此外，提示文字和对话框文字不再被裁切，读到的内容能完整保留。
body.en: When using a screen reader to change `/effort`, the selector now appears as a numbered list and asks for a typed number. A screen reader is an assistive tool that reads screen content aloud and needs an ordered way to convey choices. ⟦It is like ordering by voice without guessing among unseen buttons: hear the menu, then say the dish number.⟧ Hint text and dialog text are no longer clipped either.
body.ja: スクリーンリーダーで `/effort` を変える時、選択器は番号付きリストとして表示され、対応する数字の入力を求めるようになった。スクリーンリーダー（screen reader、画面内容を音声で読む支援ツール）は選択肢を順に伝えられる必要がある。⟦見えないボタンの位置を推測せず、メニューを聞いて料理番号を言う音声注文のようなものだ。⟧ ヒントとダイアログの文字も途中で切り取られなくなる。
body.ko: 스크린 리더로 `/effort`를 바꿀 때 선택기는 이제 번호 목록으로 보이고 해당 숫자를 입력하라고 한다. 스크린 리더(screen reader, 화면 내용을 소리 내어 읽는 보조 도구)는 선택지를 순서대로 전해야 한다. ⟦보이지 않는 버튼 위치를 짐작하지 않고 메뉴를 들은 뒤 음식 번호를 말하는 음성 주문과 같다.⟧ 힌트 글과 대화 상자 글도 더는 잘리지 않는다.

items.original: Improved screen reader mode: the `/effort` selector renders as a numbered list with a typed-number prompt, and hint and dialog text is no longer clipped

title.zh-TW: 列印模式會提示未認得的模型 ID
title.zh-CN: 打印模式会提示未识别的模型 ID
title.en: Print mode flags unrecognized model IDs
title.ja: プリントモードが認識しないモデル ID を知らせる
title.ko: 인쇄 모드가 알지 못하는 모델 ID를 알린다

body.zh-TW: 用 print mode 送出 Claude Code 不認得的 model ID 時，現在 stderr（標準錯誤輸出，程式用來報告問題的文字通道）會寫出 `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]`。這條診斷訊息告訴你請求確實帶了未識別的模型 ID。⟦像寄件櫃檯在收據蓋上「地址查無」章，而非讓包裹悄悄進入未知路線。⟧ 若想不再看到它，可用 `modelOverrides` 將該模型 ID 對應到已知模型。
body.zh-CN: 用 print mode 发出 Claude Code 不认识的 model ID 时，现在 stderr（标准错误输出，程序用来报告问题的文字通道）会写出 `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]`。这条诊断信息告诉你请求确实带了未识别的模型 ID。⟦像寄件柜台在收据盖上“地址查无”章，而不是让包裹悄悄进入未知路线。⟧ 若想不再看到它，可用 `modelOverrides` 将该模型 ID 对应到已知模型。
body.en: If print mode sends a model ID Claude Code does not recognize, stderr, the program's text channel for reporting problems, now writes `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]`. The diagnostic line tells you the request went out with an unknown model ID. ⟦It is like a mailing counter stamping “address not found” on the receipt instead of quietly sending a parcel onto an unknown route.⟧ Map that ID with `modelOverrides` to silence the line.
body.ja: print mode で Claude Code が認識しない model ID のリクエストを送ると、stderr（標準エラー出力、プログラムが問題を伝える文字の経路）へ `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]` が書かれるようになった。この診断行は、未認識の model ID でリクエストが出たことを知らせる。⟦郵便窓口が荷物を未知の経路へ黙って送らず、受領書に「住所不明」の印を押すようなものだ。⟧ 表示を止めたい時は `modelOverrides` でその ID を既知のモデルへ対応付ける。
body.ko: print mode에서 Claude Code가 알지 못하는 model ID로 요청을 보내면 이제 stderr(표준 오류 출력, 프로그램이 문제를 알리는 글자 통로)에 `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]`가 적힌다. 이 진단 줄은 요청이 인식되지 않은 model ID로 나갔음을 알려 준다. ⟦우체국 창구가 소포를 알 수 없는 길로 조용히 보내지 않고 영수증에 “주소 없음” 도장을 찍는 일과 같다.⟧ 이 줄을 없애려면 `modelOverrides`로 그 ID를 알려진 모델에 대응시킨다.

items.original: Improved print mode diagnostics: a `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]` line is written to stderr when a request goes out for a model ID Claude Code doesn't recognize; map it with `modelOverrides` to silence

title.zh-TW: 非 GitHub 儲存庫不再收到錯誤的 App 設定提醒
title.zh-CN: 非 GitHub 仓库不再收到错误的 App 设置提醒
title.en: Non-GitHub repositories stop getting wrong app setup tip
title.ja: GitHub 以外のリポジトリに誤ったアプリ設定案内を出さない
title.ko: GitHub 밖 저장소에는 잘못된 앱 설정 안내를 띄우지 않는다

body.zh-TW: 你的儲存庫 origin remote 在 gitlab.com 或 bitbucket.org 時，GitHub app 設定提示不再冒出來。origin remote（儲存庫連向遠端來源的位置）既不是 GitHub，就不該叫你設定 GitHub app。⟦像火車站不會把前往另一座城市的旅客帶到錯誤月台；現在目的地不是 GitHub，便不發那張車票。⟧ 同時，enterprise marketplace 提示會涵蓋不是 GitHub 的內部 Git 主機。
body.zh-CN: 你的仓库 origin remote 在 gitlab.com 或 bitbucket.org 时，GitHub app 设置提示不再冒出来。origin remote（仓库连向远端来源的位置）既不是 GitHub，就不该叫你设置 GitHub app。⟦像火车站不会把前往另一座城市的旅客带到错误站台；现在目的地不是 GitHub，便不发那张车票。⟧ 同时，enterprise marketplace 提示会覆盖不是 GitHub 的内部 Git 主机。
body.en: If a repository's origin remote is on gitlab.com or bitbucket.org, the GitHub app setup tip no longer appears. An origin remote is the repository's destination for its remote source, so a non-GitHub destination should not ask for GitHub app setup. ⟦It is like a station not sending travellers for another city to the wrong platform; when the destination is not GitHub, it does not issue that ticket.⟧ The enterprise marketplace tip now covers internal Git hosts that are not GitHub.
body.ja: リポジトリの origin remote が gitlab.com または bitbucket.org にある場合、GitHub app の設定案内は表示されなくなった。origin remote（リポジトリが遠隔の元データへつながる先）が GitHub ではないなら、GitHub app の設定を求めるべきではない。⟦駅が別の都市へ行く旅行者を誤ったホームへ送らないようなものだ。目的地が GitHub でなければ、その切符を出さない。⟧ enterprise marketplace の案内は、GitHub 以外の社内 Git ホストも扱う。
body.ko: 저장소의 origin remote가 gitlab.com 또는 bitbucket.org에 있으면 GitHub app 설정 안내가 더는 나오지 않는다. origin remote(저장소가 원격 원본으로 연결되는 곳)가 GitHub가 아니면 GitHub app 설정을 요구하면 안 된다. ⟦기차역이 다른 도시로 갈 승객을 잘못된 승강장으로 보내지 않는 일과 같다. 목적지가 GitHub가 아니면 그 표를 내주지 않는다.⟧ enterprise marketplace 안내는 이제 GitHub가 아닌 내부 Git 호스트도 다룬다.

items.original: Changed the GitHub app setup tip to no longer appear in repositories whose origin remote is on gitlab.com or bitbucket.org; the enterprise marketplace tip now covers non-GitHub internal git hosts

title.zh-TW: 較新模型預設不用待辦工具，仍可用環境變數取回
title.zh-CN: 较新模型默认不用待办工具，仍可用环境变量取回
title.en: Newer models hide todo tools by default, with an opt-in return
title.ja: 新しいモデルでは ToDo ツールを既定で外し、環境変数で戻せる
title.ko: 새 모델에서는 할 일 도구를 기본으로 빼고 환경 변수로 되돌린다

body.zh-TW: 使用 Opus 4.8、Sonnet 5、Fable 5、Mythos 5 或更高版本模型時，TaskCreate、TaskGet、TaskUpdate、TaskList、TodoWrite 這些待辦與任務追蹤工具不再提供。這是既有工具可用範圍的變更，不是新增工具。⟦像工具箱換了新版內裝，這批型號先把待辦抽屜收起；需要的人仍可把抽屜裝回。⟧ 要恢復它們，設定環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1`。
body.zh-CN: 使用 Opus 4.8、Sonnet 5、Fable 5、Mythos 5 或更高版本模型时，TaskCreate、TaskGet、TaskUpdate、TaskList、TodoWrite 这些待办与任务跟踪工具不再提供。这是已有工具可用范围的变更，不是新增工具。⟦像工具箱换了新版内装，这批型号先把待办抽屉收起；需要的人仍可把抽屉装回。⟧ 要恢复它们，设置环境变量 `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1`。
body.en: On Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Mythos 5, and newer models, the task-tracking tools TaskCreate, TaskGet, TaskUpdate, TaskList, and TodoWrite are no longer available. This changes the availability of existing tools; it does not add a new tool. ⟦It is like a new layout for a toolbox that stores the todo drawer away for these models, while people who need it can still put the drawer back.⟧ Set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` to restore them.
body.ja: Opus 4.8、Sonnet 5、Fable 5、Mythos 5、およびそれ以降のモデルでは、TaskCreate、TaskGet、TaskUpdate、TaskList、TodoWrite という ToDo・タスク追跡ツールを使えなくなった。これは既存ツールの利用範囲を変えるもので、新しいツールの追加ではない。⟦工具箱の新しい内装で、この型番では ToDo の引き出しをいったんしまうが、必要な人は引き出しを戻せるようなものだ。⟧ 戻すには環境変数 `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` を設定する。
body.ko: Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Mythos 5와 그보다 새 모델에서는 TaskCreate, TaskGet, TaskUpdate, TaskList, TodoWrite 같은 작업 추적 도구를 더 이상 쓸 수 없다. 이는 기존 도구의 사용 범위를 바꾸는 일이지 새 도구를 더하는 일이 아니다. ⟦도구 상자의 새 내부 구조에서 이 모델들은 할 일 서랍을 우선 넣어 두되 필요한 사람은 다시 꺼낼 수 있는 모습과 같다.⟧ 되돌리려면 환경 변수 `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1`을 설정한다.

items.original: Todo/task-tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) are no longer available on Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Mythos 5, and newer models; set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` to bring them back

title.zh-TW: Windows Bash 權限調整收回過寬規則
title.zh-CN: Windows Bash 权限调整收回过宽规则
title.en: Windows Bash permission change narrows back overly broad rules
title.ja: Windows の Bash 権限変更で広すぎた規則を戻す
title.ko: Windows Bash 권한 변경에서 너무 넓었던 규칙을 되돌린다

body.zh-TW: Windows 的 auto mode 對一般 `cd <dir> && <command> > file` Bash 指令反覆停下要求手動核准，這個 2.1.232 回歸問題已修正。同時，2.1.232 對 Cygwin 風格符號連結與輸入重新導向 `< file` 的 Bash 權限改動被撤回。⟦像門禁先把普通的進出與兩種指定通道都攔下；現在普通路線恢復通行，而過寬的兩條規則先收回，等待較精準版本。⟧ 較窄的版本會在後續版本回來。
body.zh-CN: Windows 的 auto mode 对一般 `cd <dir> && <command> > file` Bash 命令反复停下要求手动批准，这个 2.1.232 回归问题已修复。同时，2.1.232 对 Cygwin 风格符号链接与输入重定向 `< file` 的 Bash 权限改动被撤回。⟦像门禁先把普通进出与两种指定通道都拦下；现在普通路线恢复通行，而过宽的两条规则先收回，等待较精确版本。⟧ 较窄的版本会在后续版本回来。
body.en: On Windows, auto mode repeatedly stopped for manual approval on ordinary `cd <dir> && <command> > file` Bash commands; that 2.1.232 regression is fixed. At the same time, 2.1.232 Bash permission changes for Cygwin-style symlinks and input redirection `< file` have been reverted. ⟦It is like access control stopping ordinary passage and two named lanes; ordinary travel resumes, while the two overbroad rules are withdrawn until a narrower version returns.⟧ A narrower version will arrive in a later release.
body.ja: Windows の auto mode が通常の `cd <dir> && <command> > file` Bash コマンドで手動承認のため何度も止まる 2.1.232 の回帰は直った。同時に、Cygwin 形式のシンボリックリンクと入力リダイレクト `< file` に対する 2.1.232 の Bash 権限変更は元へ戻された。⟦入退室管理が通常の通行と二つの指定通路まで止めていたようなものだ。通常の通行は戻し、広すぎた二つの規則はより狭い版が来るまで引っ込める。⟧ より狭い版は後のリリースで戻る予定である。
body.ko: Windows의 auto mode가 일반 `cd <dir> && <command> > file` Bash 명령에서 수동 승인을 요구하며 거듭 멈추던 2.1.232 회귀 문제는 고쳐졌다. 동시에 Cygwin식 심볼릭 링크와 입력 리디렉션 `< file`에 대한 2.1.232 Bash 권한 변경은 되돌렸다. ⟦출입 통제가 보통 통행과 두 지정 통로까지 모두 막던 모습과 같다. 보통 길은 다시 열고 너무 넓었던 두 규칙은 더 좁은 판이 돌아올 때까지 거둔다.⟧ 더 좁은 판은 뒤 릴리스에서 돌아온다.

items.original:
Windows: fixed auto mode repeatedly stopping for manual approval on ordinary `cd <dir> && <command> > file` Bash commands (a 2.1.232 regression)
Reverted the 2.1.232 Bash permission changes for Cygwin-style symlinks on Windows and for input redirections (`< file`); a narrower version will return in a later release

entries: Subagent forking is now on by default: a `subagent_type: "fork"` subagent inherits the full conversation and prompt cache, and non-teammate agent spawns in interactive sessions now run in the background by default
Type `@` in the prompt to mention another Claude session by name; Claude then uses `SendMessage` to reach that session directly
`SendMessage` now delivers to a bare name that exactly matches one live session, instead of asking to confirm with a ref first
Interactive sessions on one machine now keep unique names: starting or renaming a session to a name another live session already uses gives it a `name-word-word` variant and tells you
Added `/config` rows for "Dialog expiry" and "Messages from your other sessions" (cross-session inbound accept/hold/refuse)

Added secret redaction for GitLab token families (`glrt-`, `gloas-`, `glptt-`, `glagent-`, `glimt-`, `glsoat-`, `glcbt-`, `glft-`, `glffct-`) and full redaction of routable `glpat-`/`gldt-` tokens; the `glab` CLI config store gets the same sandbox and credential-path protection as `gh`
Added GitLab support to plugin marketplaces: bare `gitlab.com` repo URLs (including nested subgroups) now clone like `github.com` URLs, and clone auth-failure hints name your actual git host
Settings: `additionalMarketplaces` and `allowedMarketplaces` are now accepted as friendlier aliases for `extraKnownMarketplaces` and `strictKnownMarketplaces`
Enterprise policy: a url-typed `blockedMarketplaces` entry for a bare repo URL keeps blocking that URL when the CLI classifies it as a git clone
Gateway: the `desktop:` overlay now accepts every released Desktop setting (was 11 hand-listed keys), validated at boot against Desktop's own schema; unknown or invalid keys fail boot

Gateway: empty `managed.policies[].match.groups`/`admin.admin_groups` entries and malformed `email_domain` values (empty, or containing `@`, whitespace, or commas) now fail at boot instead of silently matching no one or granting admin access
Fable 5 is offered as an advisor in `/advisor` again for organizations with Fable access, with usage-credits consent set up through `/model fable`
Fixed a PowerShell permission bypass where variable-writing parameters could silently overwrite `$PSDefaultParameterValues` and redirect later commands' file access
Fixed a Windows permission bypass where Git Bash followed Cygwin-style symlinks that path validation saw as regular files; writes through them now require permission approval
Fixed nested git repositories inheriting trust from a parent directory; each repository now requires its own trust confirmation
Fixed MCP connections hanging for the full 30-second connect timeout when a server fails to answer or sends a malformed reply to the protocol-version probe
Fixed Remote Control sessions hosted by a bridge inside a cloud session inheriting that session's transcript or credentials
Fixed Remote Control sessions started from Claude Desktop or an IDE appearing as a new claude.ai session each time the local session was resumed; they now reattach to the existing one
Fixed Remote Control sessions appearing unreachable to newly attached clients while idle
Fixed Remote Control bridge sessions not restoring conversation history when the session worker restarts
Remote Control: resuming a conversation whose session was deleted from claude.ai or the app now starts a replacement instead of failing with a message about your login (regressed in v2.1.227)
Fixed Cloud gateway `/login` exiting silently or leaving an unresponsive terminal after "Press Enter to continue" when managed settings failed to load; the reason is now shown
Fixed voice mode on native builds getting stuck on "listening…" when the voice service rejected the connection; the rejection is now shown immediately
Fixed mTLS client certificate rotation requiring a restart; Claude Code now reloads the rotated cert and key automatically on connection errors
Fixed malformed AWS or Vertex region values being used to build request URLs; they now fall back to the default region
Fixed stream idle timeout errors failing the request instead of recovering on Bedrock, Vertex, and gateway deployments
Fixed content-sized overlays containing truncated text rendering one column too wide, and start-truncated text collapsing to an ellipsis
Fixed a stray garbled character where a long shell-command or agent-description preview was cut off mid-emoji
Fixed a startup race that could silently unregister a plugin marketplace due to concurrent writes to `known_marketplaces.json`
Fixed `/update` and `/tui` refusing to restart while work that survives the relaunch was running
Fixed usage-limit guidance suggesting unavailable slash commands in SDK and remote sessions
Fixed the consent message for interactive `--advisor fable` launches, which told you to run `/model fable` in an interactive session that had just exited
Improved fullscreen streaming: long sessions stay responsive because the whole conversation is no longer re-normalized on every update

Improved the managed settings approval dialog: shows endpoint URLs, uses clearer wording for telemetry-only changes, skips routine OpenTelemetry options, and requires approval for server-managed sandbox binary overrides (`sandbox.bwrapPath`, `sandbox.socatPath`, `sandbox.ripgrep`)
`/feedback` and `/bug` now open immediately when invoked while Claude is responding, instead of waiting for the turn to finish
`/plugin install plugin@marketplace` now refreshes the marketplace first, so newly published plugins install without a manual marketplace update
`/code-review` at high, xhigh, and max effort now runs in a background agent like the other levels
Pasted and clipboard images are read without blocking the event loop
Remote Control now keeps reconnecting for about 30 minutes after a network blip and no longer drops after a few blips spread across an hour
Remote Control: resuming a conversation no longer silently takes Remote Control away from another Claude Code on the same machine that still has it; run `/remote-control` there to move it
Updated agent panel: completed subagents hide immediately with a `/tasks` footer hint, and the "↓ N more" overflow indicator moved left for visibility
Remote Control: the terminal now says whether a session was taken over by another device, ended from another app, or deleted, and stops suggesting a reconnect that would undo it
Bash input redirections (`< file`) are now permission-checked like their argument spellings on all platforms
Shortened the message shown when resuming a completed background agent
Cowork sessions no longer inline external @-imports from user-scope memory files
Hardened the auto-generated cross-session messaging socket directory on shared `/tmp`: a pre-planted symlink or another user's directory is now refused instead of used
Hardened the Linux filesystem sandbox against a protected-path bypass
Changed `sandbox.ripgrep` to be honored only from user, managed, and `--settings` settings; project settings can no longer override the sandbox's ripgrep binary
Removed the startup tip suggesting you create custom subagents, and the matching nudge in the `/powerup` tour

title.zh-TW: 分身代理接手完整脈絡，也改在背景工作
title.zh-CN: 分身代理接手完整脉络，也改在后台工作
title.en: Forked subagents keep the context and work in the background
title.ja: フォークしたサブエージェントが文脈を引き継ぎ、バックグラウンドで動く
title.ko: 포크한 하위 에이전트가 맥락을 이어받고 백그라운드에서 작업한다

body.zh-TW: 你正和 Claude 討論一個長問題，又想找另一個代理分頭處理，現在不用先把前情重講一遍。`subagent_type: "fork"` 的子代理（由目前對話分出的工作幫手）會帶著完整對話和 prompt cache，先前提示內容的暫存結果，出發。互動工作階段裡，非團隊代理的啟動預設也改為背景執行，不會把眼前對話卡在等待畫面。像把同一本已夾好書籤的筆記交給同事，他從你停下的段落開始讀，並到隔壁桌處理，不必佔著你的座位。
body.zh-CN: 你正和 Claude 讨论一个长问题，又想找另一个代理分头处理，现在不用先把前情重讲一遍。`subagent_type: "fork"` 的子代理会带着完整对话和 prompt cache（此前提示内容的暂存结果）出发。交互会话里，非团队代理的启动默认也改为后台运行，不会把眼前对话卡在等待画面。像把夹好书签的笔记交给同事，他从你停下的段落开始读，并到隔壁桌处理。
body.en: When a long conversation needs another agent, a `subagent_type: "fork"` subagent now starts with the full conversation and prompt cache, rather than needing the background repeated. In interactive sessions, non-teammate agents also start in the background by default. It is like handing a colleague a notebook already marked at the right page, then letting them work at the next desk instead of taking over yours.
body.ja: 長い相談で別のエージェントにも作業を頼みたいとき、`subagent_type: "fork"` の子エージェントは会話全体と prompt cache（これまでの指示内容を一時保存した結果）を引き継いで始まる。対話セッションでは、チーム外エージェントの起動も既定でバックグラウンド実行になる。しおりを挟んだノートを同僚へ渡し、隣の机で作業してもらうようなものだ。
body.ko: 긴 대화에서 다른 에이전트에게 일을 나눠 맡기면 `subagent_type: "fork"` 하위 에이전트가 전체 대화와 prompt cache(앞선 지시 내용을 임시 저장한 결과)를 이어받아 시작한다. 대화형 세션에서는 팀원이 아닌 에이전트도 기본으로 백그라운드에서 시작한다. 책갈피 꽂힌 노트를 동료에게 건네고 옆자리에서 일하게 하는 셈이다。

items.original: Subagent forking is now on by default: a `subagent_type: "fork"` subagent inherits the full conversation and prompt cache, and non-teammate agent spawns in interactive sessions now run in the background by default

title.zh-TW: 跨工作階段傳話，直接叫名字就能找到人
title.zh-CN: 跨会话传话，直接叫名字就能找到人
title.en: Cross-session messages can go straight to a session name
title.ja: 別セッションへの連絡は名前だけで届く
title.ko: 다른 세션에는 이름만으로 메시지를 보낸다

body.zh-TW: 同一台電腦開著幾個 Claude 工作階段時，你可以在提示裡輸入 `@` 加上另一個工作階段名稱，Claude 會用 `SendMessage` 直接傳話。名稱剛好只對應一個正在運作的工作階段時，`SendMessage` 也不再先要你用 ref（工作階段參照）確認。若新建或改名時撞名，程式會改給 `name-word-word` 形式的名稱並告知你。`/config` 還新增 Dialog expiry 與 Messages from your other sessions，可設定跨工作階段訊息要接受、暫留或拒絕。像辦公室分機有各自號碼，接線台替你避免重號，也讓你決定別人來電要接、稍後看，或不接。
body.zh-CN: 同一台电脑开着几个 Claude 会话时，你可在提示里输入 `@` 加上另一个会话名称，Claude 会用 `SendMessage` 直接传话。名称只对应一个正在运行的会话时，也不再先要求 ref（会话引用）确认。新建或改名撞名会改成 `name-word-word` 并告知你。`/config` 新增 Dialog expiry 和 Messages from your other sessions，可选择接受、暂留或拒绝跨会话消息。
body.en: With several Claude sessions on one machine, type `@` and a session name in the prompt to send it a `SendMessage`. A bare name that exactly matches one live session no longer needs a ref confirmation. Duplicate names receive a `name-word-word` variant. `/config` also adds Dialog expiry and Messages from your other sessions, where inbound cross-session messages can be accepted, held, or refused.
body.ja: 一台の端末で複数の Claude セッションを開いているなら、プロンプトで `@` と別セッション名を入力すると `SendMessage` で直接連絡できる。一つの稼働中セッションにだけ一致する名前なら ref（セッション参照）の確認は不要である。名前が重なると `name-word-word` 形式に変わる。`/config` には Dialog expiry と Messages from your other sessions が加わり、受信を受け入れる、保留する、拒否するを選べる。
body.ko: 한 컴퓨터에서 Claude 세션을 여러 개 열었다면 프롬프트에 `@`와 다른 세션 이름을 입력해 `SendMessage`를 보낼 수 있다. 이름이 실행 중인 세션 하나에만 정확히 맞으면 ref(세션 참조)를 확인하지 않는다. 이름이 겹치면 `name-word-word` 형식으로 바뀐다. `/config`에는 Dialog expiry와 Messages from your other sessions가 추가되어 수신을 받기, 보류, 거절로 정한다。

items.original:
Type `@` in the prompt to mention another Claude session by name; Claude then uses `SendMessage` to reach that session directly
`SendMessage` now delivers to a bare name that exactly matches one live session, instead of asking to confirm with a ref first
Interactive sessions on one machine now keep unique names: starting or renaming a session to a name another live session already uses gives it a `name-word-word` variant and tells you
Added `/config` rows for "Dialog expiry" and "Messages from your other sessions" (cross-session inbound accept/hold/refuse)

title.zh-TW: GitLab 憑證遮住，外掛市集也認得 GitLab
title.zh-CN: GitLab 凭证遮住，插件市场也认得 GitLab
title.en: GitLab credentials are redacted and GitLab repositories work in marketplaces
title.ja: GitLab の認証情報を伏せ、プラグイン市場でも GitLab を扱える
title.ko: GitLab 자격 증명을 가리고 플러그인 마켓에서도 GitLab을 쓴다

body.zh-TW: 把 GitLab 當成外掛來源時，現在連線和保護都補齊了。GitLab 的 `glrt-`、`gloas-`、`glptt-`、`glagent-`、`glimt-`、`glsoat-`、`glcbt-`、`glft-`、`glffct-` token（登入授權令牌）會遮蔽；可路由的 `glpat-` 與 `gldt-` 會完整遮蔽。`glab` CLI 的設定儲存位置也取得與 `gh` 相同的 sandbox（限制程式可碰範圍的隔離區）和憑證路徑保護。外掛市集則可直接複製 `gitlab.com` 倉庫網址，含巢狀子群組；複製驗證失敗時，提示會指出實際 Git 主機。像市集同時換了能讀 GitLab 地址的物流單，也替倉庫鑰匙加上遮套。
body.zh-CN: 把 GitLab 当成插件来源时，现在连线和保护都补齐了。GitLab 的 `glrt-`、`gloas-`、`glptt-`、`glagent-`、`glimt-`、`glsoat-`、`glcbt-`、`glft-`、`glffct-` token（登录授权令牌）会遮蔽；可路由的 `glpat-` 与 `gldt-` 会完整遮蔽。`glab` CLI 的配置存储位置也得到与 `gh` 相同的 sandbox（限制程序可接触范围的隔离区）和凭证路径保护。插件市场可直接克隆 `gitlab.com` 仓库网址，包含嵌套子组；验证失败提示会指出实际 Git 主机。
body.en: GitLab is now safer and easier to use as a plugin source. The listed GitLab token families are redacted, and routable `glpat-` and `gldt-` tokens are fully redacted. The `glab` CLI config store gets the same sandbox and credential-path protection as `gh`. Plugin marketplaces can clone bare `gitlab.com` repository URLs, including nested subgroups, and authentication-failure hints name the real Git host.
body.ja: GitLab をプラグインの入手先にする際の接続と保護が整った。列挙された GitLab token（ログイン用の認可トークン）は伏せ字になり、経路指定可能な `glpat-` と `gldt-` は完全に伏せられる。`glab` CLI の設定保存先は `gh` と同じ sandbox（プログラムが触れられる範囲を制限する隔離領域）と認証情報パス保護を得た。プラグイン市場は入れ子の subgroup を含む `gitlab.com` URL を複製でき、認証失敗時には実際の Git ホストを示す。
body.ko: GitLab을 플러그인 출처로 쓸 때 연결과 보호가 갖춰졌다. 나열된 GitLab token(로그인 권한 토큰)은 가려지고 경로 지정 가능한 `glpat-`, `gldt-`는 완전히 가려진다. `glab` CLI 설정 저장소도 `gh`와 같은 sandbox(프로그램이 닿는 범위를 제한하는 격리 영역)와 자격 증명 경로 보호를 받는다. 플러그인 마켓은 중첩 subgroup을 포함한 `gitlab.com` 주소를 복제하며 인증 실패 때 실제 Git 호스트를 알린다。

items.original:
Added secret redaction for GitLab token families (`glrt-`, `gloas-`, `glptt-`, `glagent-`, `glimt-`, `glsoat-`, `glcbt-`, `glft-`, `glffct-`) and full redaction of routable `glpat-`/`gldt-` tokens; the `glab` CLI config store gets the same sandbox and credential-path protection as `gh`
Added GitLab support to plugin marketplaces: bare `gitlab.com` repo URLs (including nested subgroups) now clone like `github.com` URLs, and clone auth-failure hints name your actual git host

title.zh-TW: 外掛市集名稱好記，更新後就能安裝新外掛
title.zh-CN: 插件市场名称好记，刷新后就能安装新插件
title.en: Plugin marketplace settings get friendlier names and installs refresh first
title.ja: プラグイン市場の設定名が分かりやすくなり、インストール前に更新される
title.ko: 플러그인 마켓 설정 이름이 쉬워지고 설치 전에 새로 고친다

body.zh-TW: 管理外掛市集時，設定名稱不必死背舊名字。`additionalMarketplaces` 可以當 `extraKnownMarketplaces` 的別名，`allowedMarketplaces` 可以當 `strictKnownMarketplaces` 的別名；原有設定仍是同一件事。企業政策裡，`blockedMarketplaces` 將純倉庫網址標為要封鎖時，即使 CLI 把它當成 Git 複製來源，封鎖仍會生效。執行 `/plugin install plugin@marketplace` 前，程式也會先更新市集，所以剛發布的外掛不用手動更新市集才裝得到。這像採購目錄換了容易懂的欄位名，黑名單不因貨品改走物流單就失效，櫃台也會先翻到最新版目錄再下單。
body.zh-CN: 管理插件市场时，设置名称不必死背旧名字。`additionalMarketplaces` 可作为 `extraKnownMarketplaces` 的别名，`allowedMarketplaces` 可作为 `strictKnownMarketplaces` 的别名。企业政策中，`blockedMarketplaces` 把纯仓库网址标为封锁时，即使 CLI 将其当 Git 克隆来源，封锁仍有效。运行 `/plugin install plugin@marketplace` 前会先刷新市场，刚发布的插件无需手动更新市场才能安装。
body.en: Marketplace settings now accept `additionalMarketplaces` for `extraKnownMarketplaces` and `allowedMarketplaces` for `strictKnownMarketplaces`. A URL-typed `blockedMarketplaces` policy entry still blocks a bare repository URL when the CLI treats it as a Git clone. `/plugin install plugin@marketplace` refreshes the marketplace first, so newly published plugins do not require a manual marketplace update.
body.ja: プラグイン市場の設定では、`additionalMarketplaces` を `extraKnownMarketplaces` の、`allowedMarketplaces` を `strictKnownMarketplaces` の別名として使える。企業ポリシーの `blockedMarketplaces` が素のリポジトリ URL を遮断した場合、CLI が Git clone と分類しても遮断は維持される。`/plugin install plugin@marketplace` は先に市場を更新するため、新公開のプラグインを手動更新なしで入れられる。
body.ko: 플러그인 마켓 설정에서 `additionalMarketplaces`는 `extraKnownMarketplaces`의, `allowedMarketplaces`는 `strictKnownMarketplaces`의 별칭으로 쓴다. 기업 정책의 `blockedMarketplaces`가 저장소 URL을 막으면 CLI가 Git 복제로 분류해도 계속 막는다. `/plugin install plugin@marketplace`는 먼저 마켓을 새로 고쳐 새 플러그인을 수동 업데이트 없이 설치한다。

items.original:
Settings: `additionalMarketplaces` and `allowedMarketplaces` are now accepted as friendlier aliases for `extraKnownMarketplaces` and `strictKnownMarketplaces`
Enterprise policy: a url-typed `blockedMarketplaces` entry for a bare repo URL keeps blocking that URL when the CLI classifies it as a git clone
`/plugin install plugin@marketplace` now refreshes the marketplace first, so newly published plugins install without a manual marketplace update

title.zh-TW: Gateway 設定先驗證，不再悄悄套錯規則
title.zh-CN: Gateway 设置先验证，不再悄悄套错规则
title.en: Gateway validates Desktop settings and policies before it starts
title.ja: Gateway は起動前に Desktop 設定とポリシーを検証する
title.ko: Gateway가 시작 전에 Desktop 설정과 정책을 검증한다

body.zh-TW: 公司透過 Gateway 管理 Claude Desktop 設定時，錯的設定不會再表面啟動成功、背後卻沒套用。`desktop:` overlay（覆蓋 Desktop 設定的設定層）現在接受所有已發布的 Desktop 設定，並在啟動時依 Desktop 自己的 schema 驗證。schema 就是設定格式的規則，未知或無效的鍵會讓啟動失敗。政策中空的 `managed.policies[].match.groups` 或 `admin.admin_groups`，以及空白、含 `@`、空白字元或逗號的 `email_domain`，也會在啟動時失敗，避免誰都沒比對到或意外取得管理權。像門禁名冊先逐欄檢查，缺欄或寫壞就不開門，不讓錯誤名單默默決定誰能進來。
body.zh-CN: 公司通过 Gateway 管理 Claude Desktop 设置时，错误设置不会再表面启动成功、背后却没应用。`desktop:` overlay（覆盖 Desktop 设置的设置层）现接受所有已发布的 Desktop 设置，并在启动时按 Desktop 自己的 schema，设置格式规则，验证；未知或无效键会令启动失败。策略中空的 `managed.policies[].match.groups` 或 `admin.admin_groups`，以及空白、含 `@`、空白字符或逗号的 `email_domain` 也会启动失败，避免没人匹配或意外获得管理员权限。
body.en: Gateway now accepts every released Desktop setting in the `desktop:` overlay and validates it against Desktop's schema at boot; unknown or invalid keys fail boot. Empty `managed.policies[].match.groups` or `admin.admin_groups`, and malformed `email_domain` values, also fail boot instead of silently matching nobody or granting admin access.
body.ja: Gateway で Claude Desktop 設定を管理する場合、`desktop:` overlay（Desktop 設定を上書きする設定層）は公開済みの全設定を受け入れる。起動時には Desktop の schema（設定形式の規則）で検証する。未知または無効な鍵は起動を失敗させる。空の `managed.policies[].match.groups`、`admin.admin_groups`、不正な `email_domain` も、誰にも一致しない、または管理者権限を与える前に失敗する。
body.ko: Gateway로 Claude Desktop 설정을 관리할 때 `desktop:` overlay(Desktop 설정을 덮는 설정 층)는 공개된 모든 Desktop 설정을 받는다. 시작할 때는 Desktop schema(설정 형식 규칙)로 검증한다. 알 수 없거나 잘못된 키는 시작을 실패시킨다. 비어 있는 `managed.policies[].match.groups`, `admin.admin_groups`, 잘못된 `email_domain`도 아무와도 맞지 않거나 관리자 권한을 주기 전에 실패한다。

items.original:
Gateway: the `desktop:` overlay now accepts every released Desktop setting (was 11 hand-listed keys), validated at boot against Desktop's own schema; unknown or invalid keys fail boot
Gateway: empty `managed.policies[].match.groups`/`admin.admin_groups` entries and malformed `email_domain` values (empty, or containing `@`, whitespace, or commas) now fail at boot instead of silently matching no one or granting admin access

title.zh-TW: Fable 5 顧問回來了，離開互動模式也不會拿錯指示
title.zh-CN: Fable 5 顾问回来了，离开交互模式也不会拿错指示
title.en: Fable 5 returns to Advisor with a corrected consent message
title.ja: Fable 5 が Advisor に戻り、同意案内も正しくなった
title.ko: Fable 5가 Advisor에 돌아오고 동의 안내도 바로잡혔다

body.zh-TW: 組織有 Fable 存取權時，現在可在 `/advisor` 再次選到 Fable 5。要使用額度時，先透過 `/model fable` 設好 usage-credits consent（使用額度的同意）。若你在互動模式用 `--advisor fable` 啟動，舊訊息曾叫你回互動工作階段執行 `/model fable`，但那個工作階段剛好已結束，指示根本走不通。現在同意訊息已修正，不會把你指向已關閉的門。像顧問重新列進預約名單，櫃台也不再叫你回已打烊的窗口辦手續。
body.zh-CN: 组织有 Fable 访问权限时，现在可在 `/advisor` 再次选到 Fable 5。使用额度前，通过 `/model fable` 设置 usage-credits consent（使用额度的同意）。在交互模式用 `--advisor fable` 启动时，旧消息曾要求回到刚结束的交互会话运行 `/model fable`；现在指示已修正。像顾问重新列进预约名单，柜台也不再叫你回已打烊的窗口办手续。
body.en: Organizations with Fable access can again choose Fable 5 in `/advisor`, with usage-credits consent set through `/model fable`. The consent message for interactive `--advisor fable` launches no longer tells you to run `/model fable` in an interactive session that has just exited.
body.ja: Fable へのアクセスを持つ組織では、Fable 5 を再び `/advisor` で選べる。usage-credits consent（利用枠使用への同意）は `/model fable` で設定する。対話的な `--advisor fable` 起動では、終了したばかりの対話セッションで `/model fable` を実行せよという案内が出ていたが、修正された。
body.ko: Fable 접근 권한이 있는 조직은 `/advisor`에서 다시 Fable 5를 고른다. usage-credits consent(사용 한도 이용 동의)는 `/model fable`로 설정한다. 대화형 `--advisor fable` 실행 때 막 끝난 대화 세션에서 `/model fable`를 실행하라고 하던 안내도 고쳐졌다。

items.original:
Fable 5 is offered as an advisor in `/advisor` again for organizations with Fable access, with usage-credits consent set up through `/model fable`
Fixed the consent message for interactive `--advisor fable` launches, which told you to run `/model fable` in an interactive session that had just exited

title.zh-TW: 命令改寫檔案與輸入重導，都重新要過同意
title.zh-CN: 命令改写文件与输入重定向，都重新要求同意
title.en: Commands that can redirect file access now require permission approval
title.ja: ファイルアクセスを向け替えるコマンドは許可を求めるようになった
title.ko: 파일 접근을 돌릴 수 있는 명령은 권한 승인을 요구한다

body.zh-TW: 權限確認不是只看命令表面長相。PowerShell 的會寫入變數參數原本可悄悄覆寫 `$PSDefaultParameterValues`，再把後續命令的檔案存取導向別處，這條繞過已封住。Windows 上 Git Bash 把 Cygwin-style symlink（Cygwin 格式的符號連結，指向另一位置的捷徑檔）當一般檔案看，卻會跟著它寫入；現在這類寫入需要權限同意。所有平台的 Bash 輸入重導 `< file` 也和一般參數拼法一樣納入權限檢查。像保全不只查門牌，也會看通往後門的暗道和代收指示；能把手伸到別處的路，都先要你點頭。
body.zh-CN: 权限确认不只看命令表面。PowerShell 的可写变量参数原本能悄悄覆盖 `$PSDefaultParameterValues`，再将后续命令的文件访问导向别处，此绕过已封住。Windows 上 Git Bash 将 Cygwin-style symlink（Cygwin 格式的符号链接，指向另一位置的快捷文件）当普通文件看，却会跟着写入；现在此类写入需要权限同意。所有平台的 Bash 输入重定向 `< file` 也和普通参数一样纳入检查。
body.en: Permission checks now cover routes that can redirect file access. PowerShell parameters that write variables can no longer silently overwrite `$PSDefaultParameterValues` and redirect later commands. Git Bash writes through Cygwin-style symlinks on Windows require approval, and Bash input redirections (`< file`) are permission-checked on every platform.
body.ja: 権限確認はコマンドの見た目だけを見なくなった。PowerShell の変数書き込みパラメーターによる `$PSDefaultParameterValues` の上書きと、その後のファイルアクセスの向け替えは防がれる。Windows の Git Bash で Cygwin-style symlink（別の場所を指すショートカットファイル）経由に書き込む場合も許可が必要である。Bash の入力リダイレクト（`< file`）も全プラットフォームで検査される。
body.ko: 권한 확인은 명령의 겉모양만 보지 않는다. PowerShell의 변수 쓰기 매개변수로 `$PSDefaultParameterValues`를 몰래 덮고 이후 파일 접근을 돌리던 우회가 막혔다. Windows Git Bash에서 Cygwin-style symlink(다른 위치를 가리키는 바로 가기 파일)을 따라 쓰는 일도 승인이 필요하다. Bash 입력 리디렉션(`< file`)도 모든 플랫폼에서 검사한다。

items.original:
Fixed a PowerShell permission bypass where variable-writing parameters could silently overwrite `$PSDefaultParameterValues` and redirect later commands' file access
Fixed a Windows permission bypass where Git Bash followed Cygwin-style symlinks that path validation saw as regular files; writes through them now require permission approval
Bash input redirections (`< file`) are now permission-checked like their argument spellings on all platforms

title.zh-TW: 巢狀 Git 專案各自確認信任
title.zh-CN: 嵌套 Git 项目各自确认信任
title.en: Nested Git repositories now earn trust separately
title.ja: 入れ子の Git リポジトリは個別に信頼確認を受ける
title.ko: 중첩 Git 저장소는 각각 신뢰를 확인한다

body.zh-TW: 一個 Git 專案裡如果再放另一個 Git 專案，內層專案不會再因為外層資料夾已被信任，就自動繼承並通過。現在每個巢狀 repository（程式碼版本管理專案）都需要各自獲得獨立的信任確認。這項修正保留了你已信任外層資料夾的意思，同時不會把那份信任自動擴張到裡面包含的另一份專案。像你同意朋友進大樓大門，不等於也同意他打開大樓內的每一戶房門；每扇內門仍需要各自獨立確認。
body.zh-CN: 一个 Git 项目里再放另一个 Git 项目，内层不会再因外层已被信任就自动通过。现在每个嵌套 repository（代码版本管理项目）都要自己的信任确认。这保留了你信任外层文件夹的意思，也不把信任扩张到里面另一份项目。像同意朋友进大楼，不等于同意他打开楼内每一户门。
body.en: A Git repository inside another Git repository no longer inherits trust from its parent directory. Each repository now needs its own trust confirmation. Trusting the outer project still means trusting that project; it does not automatically extend to a separate project inside it.
body.ja: Git リポジトリの中に別の Git リポジトリがある場合、内側は親ディレクトリの信頼を引き継がない。各 repository（コードの版管理プロジェクト）が個別に信頼確認を受ける。外側のプロジェクトを信頼することは、その内側の別プロジェクトまで自動で信頼することではない。
body.ko: Git 저장소 안에 다른 Git 저장소가 있으면 안쪽은 부모 디렉터리의 신뢰를 물려받지 않는다. 각 repository(코드 버전 관리 프로젝트)가 따로 신뢰 확인을 받는다. 바깥 프로젝트를 신뢰해도 안의 별도 프로젝트까지 자동으로 신뢰하지 않는다。

items.original: Fixed nested git repositories inheriting trust from a parent directory; each repository now requires its own trust confirmation

title.zh-TW: MCP 伺服器不回話時，連線不再久等
title.zh-CN: MCP 服务器不回话时，连接不再久等
title.en: MCP connections stop waiting so long for a broken server reply
title.ja: MCP サーバーが応答しないとき、接続が長く待たなくなった
title.ko: MCP 서버가 응답하지 않으면 연결이 오래 기다리지 않는다

body.zh-TW: 外部工具連不上時，Claude 不會再傻等完整的連線逾時。MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器若沒有回覆，或回覆 protocol-version probe，確認雙方協定版本的詢問，時格式壞掉，舊行為會一路等到完整的 30-second connect timeout。現在這種失敗會及早結束。它像按門鈴後對方完全沒回應，或從門縫遞出看不懂的紙條；你不用站在門前一直等，能早點知道這扇門暫時進不去。
body.zh-CN: 外部工具连不上时，Claude 不会再傻等完整的连接超时。MCP（Model Context Protocol，让 AI 连接外部工具的协议）服务器若没有回复，或回复 protocol-version probe，确认双方协议版本的询问，时格式坏掉，旧行为会等到完整的 30-second connect timeout。现在这种失败会更早结束。像按门铃后对方没回应，或从门缝递出看不懂的纸条，你不用一直站在门前等。
body.en: When an MCP server does not answer, or gives a malformed reply to the protocol-version probe, a connection no longer waits through the full 30-second connect timeout. MCP is the protocol that connects AI to external tools. It is like ringing a doorbell and getting either silence or an unreadable note; you find out sooner that this door cannot be used now.
body.ja: 外部ツールにつながらないとき、MCP（Model Context Protocol、AI を外部ツールへ接続する協定）サーバーが応答しないことがある。また、protocol-version probe（双方の協定版を確かめる問い合わせ）へ壊れた応答を返す場合も、接続は完全な 30-second connect timeout まで待たなくなった。呼び鈴に返事がない、または読めない紙だけが出てくる扉の前で待ち続けなくてよい。
body.ko: 외부 도구에 연결되지 않을 때 MCP(Model Context Protocol, AI를 외부 도구에 연결하는 규약) 서버가 응답하지 않는 경우가 있다. protocol-version probe(양쪽 규약 버전을 확인하는 질의)에 잘못된 답을 보내더라도 더는 전체 30-second connect timeout까지 기다리지 않는다. 초인종을 눌러도 답이 없거나 읽을 수 없는 쪽지만 나오는 문 앞에 계속 서 있지 않는 셈이다。

items.original: Fixed MCP connections hanging for the full 30-second connect timeout when a server fails to answer or sends a malformed reply to the protocol-version probe

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制續接回原對話，歷史也能復原
title.zh-CN: 远程控制续接回原对话，历史也能恢复
title.en: Remote Control reconnects to the right conversation and restores its history
title.ja: リモートコントロールが元の会話へ再接続し、履歴も復元する
title.ko: 원격 제어가 원래 대화에 다시 붙고 기록도 복원한다

body.zh-TW: 你從 Claude Desktop 或 IDE 用 Remote Control（遠端控制，把本機工作階段接到另一端使用）後暫停再回來，現在會重新接到原本的 claude.ai 工作階段，不會每次都被當成新工作階段。新接上的用戶端在閒置時也不會顯示連不到，bridge（連接兩端的橋接程式）工作階段的 worker，實際處理工作的程序，重啟後，對話歷史會恢復。若 claude.ai 或應用程式已刪掉原工作階段，恢復對話則會開始替代工作階段，不會錯說是登入問題。像遠端回辦公桌時，能找回原本抽屜與筆記；抽屜真被清空才換一張新桌，而不是誤說你的門禁卡失效。
body.zh-CN: 你从 Claude Desktop 或 IDE 用 Remote Control（远程控制，把本机会话接到另一端使用）后暂停再回来，现在会重新接到原来的 claude.ai 会话，不会每次都被当成新会话。新接上的客户端闲置时也不会显示连不上，bridge（连接两端的桥接程序）会话的 worker，实际处理工作的进程，重启后会恢复对话历史。若 claude.ai 或应用已删掉原会话，恢复时会启动替代会话，不会错说是登录问题。
body.en: Remote Control sessions started from Claude Desktop or an IDE now reattach to the existing claude.ai session when resumed, rather than appearing new each time. Newly attached clients remain reachable while idle, and bridge-session history is restored after its worker restarts. If the original session was deleted from claude.ai or the app, resuming starts a replacement instead of reporting a login problem.
body.ja: Claude Desktop または IDE から始めた Remote Control（リモートコントロール、ローカルのセッションを別の場所から使う機能）は、再開時に毎回新しい claude.ai セッションとして現れず、既存のものへ再接続する。新しく接続したクライアントはアイドル中も到達不能と表示されず、bridge（両端をつなぐ中継プログラム）の接続を保つ。その worker（実作業を処理するプロセス）が再起動しても会話履歴を復元する。元のセッションが削除済みなら、再開はログイン問題とせず代替を始める。
body.ko: Claude Desktop이나 IDE에서 시작한 Remote Control(원격 제어, 로컬 세션을 다른 곳에서 쓰는 기능)은 다시 열 때마다 새 claude.ai 세션으로 보이지 않고 기존 세션에 다시 붙는다. 새로 붙은 클라이언트는 유휴 상태에도 닿지 않는다고 보이지 않으며 bridge(양쪽을 잇는 중계 프로그램) 연결을 유지한다. 그 worker(실제 일을 처리하는 프로세스)가 다시 시작해도 대화 기록을 복원한다. 원래 세션이 삭제됐다면 로그인 문제라고 하지 않고 대체 세션을 시작한다。

items.original:
Fixed Remote Control sessions started from Claude Desktop or an IDE appearing as a new claude.ai session each time the local session was resumed; they now reattach to the existing one
Fixed Remote Control sessions appearing unreachable to newly attached clients while idle
Fixed Remote Control bridge sessions not restoring conversation history when the session worker restarts
Remote Control: resuming a conversation whose session was deleted from claude.ai or the app now starts a replacement instead of failing with a message about your login (regressed in v2.1.227)

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制斷線會重連，也會說清楚控制權去哪了
title.zh-CN: 远程控制断线会重连，也会说清控制权去哪了
title.en: Remote Control reconnects after a blip and explains who has control
title.ja: リモートコントロールは切断後に再接続し、制御権の行方を示す
title.ko: 원격 제어는 끊긴 뒤 다시 연결하고 제어권의 행방을 알린다

body.zh-TW: 網路一晃、或同一台機器上另一個 Claude Code 接手時，Remote Control 不再默默把你留在猜測裡。網路短暫中斷後，它會持續嘗試重連約 30 minutes，也不會因為跨 1 hour 出現幾次短暫中斷就放棄。若另一個 Claude Code 仍握有控制權，恢復對話不會悄悄搶走它；要移轉請在那裡執行 `/remote-control`。終端機也會明說工作階段被別台裝置接手、從其他應用程式結束，或已刪除，並停止建議會把變更撤銷的重連。像接力棒還在別人手上時，裁判會告訴你原因與交棒位置，而不是讓兩個人同時伸手搶。
body.zh-CN: 网络一晃、或同一台机器上另一个 Claude Code 接手时，Remote Control 不再让你猜。网络短暂中断后，它会持续尝试重连约 30 minutes，也不会因跨 1 hour 出现几次短暂中断就放弃。若另一个 Claude Code 仍握有控制权，恢复对话不会悄悄抢走它；请在那边运行 `/remote-control` 移交。终端也会说明会话被别台设备接手、从其他应用结束或删除，并停止建议会撤销变更的重连。
body.en: After a network blip, Remote Control keeps reconnecting for about 30 minutes and no longer drops after a few blips spread across an hour. Resuming does not silently take control from another Claude Code on the same machine; run `/remote-control` there to move it. The terminal now says whether another device took over, another app ended, or deleted the session, and stops suggesting a reconnect that would undo that state.
body.ja: ネットワークが途切れた後、Remote Control は約 30 minutes 再接続を試み、1 hour に散らばった数回の切断で落ちなくなった。同じ端末の別の Claude Code が制御中なら、再開しても黙って奪わない。移すにはそちらで `/remote-control` を実行する。端末は別デバイスによる引き継ぎ、別アプリからの終了、削除を表示し、その状態を取り消す再接続は勧めない。
body.ko: 네트워크가 잠깐 끊긴 뒤 Remote Control은 약 30 minutes 동안 다시 연결을 시도하고 1 hour에 걸쳐 몇 번 끊겼다고 떨어지지 않는다. 같은 컴퓨터의 다른 Claude Code가 제어 중이면 다시 열어도 몰래 빼앗지 않으며 그쪽에서 `/remote-control`을 실행해 옮긴다. 터미널은 다른 기기의 인수, 다른 앱의 종료, 삭제를 알리고 그 상태를 되돌릴 재연결은 권하지 않는다。

items.original:
Remote Control now keeps reconnecting for about 30 minutes after a network blip and no longer drops after a few blips spread across an hour
Remote Control: resuming a conversation no longer silently takes Remote Control away from another Claude Code on the same machine that still has it; run `/remote-control` there to move it
Remote Control: the terminal now says whether a session was taken over by another device, ended from another app, or deleted, and stops suggesting a reconnect that would undo it

title.zh-TW: 雲端登入與語音被拒，現在會直接告訴你原因
title.zh-CN: 云端登录与语音被拒，现在会直接告诉你原因
title.en: Cloud login and rejected voice connections now show the reason
title.ja: クラウドログインと拒否された音声接続が理由を表示する
title.ko: 클라우드 로그인과 거부된 음성 연결이 이유를 보여 준다

body.zh-TW: 按下 Cloud gateway 的 `/login`，看到「Press Enter to continue」後卻沒反應，舊版可能直接離開或留下無回應的終端機；原因是受管理設定載入失敗。現在它會顯示原因。原生版本的 voice mode（語音模式）若被語音服務拒絕，以前可能卡在「listening…」，現在也會立即顯示拒絕。兩件事都把原本沉默的失敗變成可讀訊息：像櫃台不能替你辦理時，會說明缺哪張資料，而不是把你晾在寫著「請稍候」的牌子前。
body.zh-CN: 按 Cloud gateway 的 `/login`，看到“Press Enter to continue”后没反应，旧版可能直接退出或留下无响应的终端；原因是托管设置加载失败。现在会显示原因。原生版本的 voice mode（语音模式）若被语音服务拒绝，以前可能卡在“listening…”，现在也会立即显示拒绝。它们都把沉默失败变成可读消息。
body.en: When managed settings fail to load, Cloud gateway `/login` no longer exits silently or leaves an unresponsive terminal after “Press Enter to continue”; it shows the reason. On native builds, voice mode no longer stays on “listening…” when the voice service rejects its connection; that rejection appears immediately.
body.ja: 管理設定の読み込みに失敗した場合、Cloud gateway の `/login` は「Press Enter to continue」の後で黙って終了したり、応答しない端末を残したりせず、理由を表示する。ネイティブ版の voice mode（音声モード）も、音声サービスに接続を拒否されて「listening…」で止まらず、拒否をすぐ表示する。
body.ko: 관리 설정을 불러오지 못하면 Cloud gateway `/login`은 “Press Enter to continue” 뒤에 조용히 끝나거나 응답 없는 터미널을 남기지 않고 이유를 보인다. 네이티브 빌드의 voice mode(음성 모드)도 음성 서비스가 연결을 거부했을 때 “listening…”에 멈추지 않고 거부를 바로 보인다。

items.original:
Fixed Cloud gateway `/login` exiting silently or leaving an unresponsive terminal after "Press Enter to continue" when managed settings failed to load; the reason is now shown
Fixed voice mode on native builds getting stuck on "listening…" when the voice service rejected the connection; the rejection is now shown immediately

title.zh-TW: 雲端連線可換新憑證，也能從逾時接回工作
title.zh-CN: 云端连接可换新凭证，也能从超时接回工作
title.en: Cloud connections reload rotated certificates and recover from idle timeouts
title.ja: クラウド接続は更新済み証明書を読み直し、アイドルタイムアウトから回復する
title.ko: 클라우드 연결이 교체된 인증서를 다시 읽고 유휴 시간 초과에서 복구한다

body.zh-TW: mTLS client certificate（mTLS 用戶端憑證，雙向驗證連線身分的證明）輪替後，舊版要重啟 Claude Code 才會讀到新憑證與金鑰；現在遇到連線錯誤會自動重新載入。Bedrock、Vertex 與 gateway 部署遇到 stream idle timeout（串流閒置逾時）時，舊版會讓請求失敗，現在會嘗試恢復。AWS 或 Vertex 的 region（服務區域）值格式壞掉時，也不再拿它拼出請求網址，會改回 default region。像長途電話遇到換發的新識別證或短暫靜音，接線員會重讀證件、改撥預設區域並嘗試接回通話。
body.zh-CN: mTLS client certificate（mTLS 客户端证书，双向验证连接身份的证明）轮换后，旧版需重启 Claude Code 才读到新证书和密钥；现在遇到连接错误会自动重载。Bedrock、Vertex 与 gateway 部署遇到 stream idle timeout（流式空闲超时）时，旧版会让请求失败，现在会恢复。AWS 或 Vertex 的 region（服务区域）值格式损坏时，也不再用它拼请求网址，会回到 default region。
body.en: After an mTLS client certificate rotation, Claude Code now reloads the certificate and key on connection errors instead of requiring a restart. Bedrock, Vertex, and gateway deployments recover from stream idle timeout errors rather than failing the request. Malformed AWS or Vertex region values no longer build request URLs and fall back to the default region.
body.ja: mTLS client certificate（mTLS クライアント証明書、相互認証で接続の身元を示す証明）の更新後、Claude Code は再起動を待たず、接続エラー時に証明書と鍵を再読み込みする。Bedrock、Vertex、gateway 配置では stream idle timeout（ストリームのアイドル時間超過）が要求を失敗させず回復する。壊れた AWS または Vertex の region（サービス地域）値は URL 作成に使わず default region へ戻る。
body.ko: mTLS client certificate(mTLS 클라이언트 인증서, 상호 인증에서 연결 신원을 보이는 증명서)가 교체된 뒤 Claude Code는 재시작 대신 연결 오류 때 인증서와 키를 다시 읽는다. Bedrock, Vertex, gateway 배포에서는 stream idle timeout(스트림 유휴 시간 초과)이 요청을 실패시키지 않고 복구한다. 잘못된 AWS나 Vertex region(서비스 지역) 값은 URL을 만들지 않고 default region으로 돌아간다。

items.original:
Fixed mTLS client certificate rotation requiring a restart; Claude Code now reloads the rotated cert and key automatically on connection errors
Fixed malformed AWS or Vertex region values being used to build request URLs; they now fall back to the default region
Fixed stream idle timeout errors failing the request instead of recovering on Bedrock, Vertex, and gateway deployments

title.zh-TW: 被截斷的文字不再撐寬畫面或冒出亂碼
title.zh-CN: 被截断的文字不再撑宽画面或冒出乱码
title.en: Truncated text no longer widens overlays or leaves a garbled character
title.ja: 切り詰めた文字が画面を広げたり文字化けしたりしなくなった
title.ko: 잘린 글자가 화면을 넓히거나 깨진 글자를 남기지 않는다

body.zh-TW: 畫面上的 overlay（覆蓋在主畫面上的小面板）依內容決定寬度時，文字被截斷會不再多畫出一欄；從開頭截斷的文字也不會縮成只有省略號。很長的 shell command（殼層命令）或 agent description，代理描述，預覽在 emoji，表情符號，中間被切斷時，先前還可能留下一個亂碼字元，現在已修好。這些都是同一個「文字只顯示一部分」的邊角：像招牌裁短字句時，不會多做一格空白，也不會把圖案切成一塊看不懂的碎片。
body.zh-CN: 画面上的 overlay（覆盖在主画面上的小面板）按内容决定宽度时，文字截断不会再多画一列；从开头截断的文字也不会缩成只有省略号。很长的 shell command（Shell 命令）或 agent description，代理描述，预览在 emoji，表情符号，中间被切断时，也不再留下乱码字符。像招牌裁短字句时，不会多做一格空白，也不会把图案切成看不懂的碎片。
body.en: A content-sized overlay no longer renders one column too wide when its text is truncated, and text truncated at the start no longer collapses to an ellipsis. A long shell-command or agent-description preview cut mid-emoji also no longer leaves a stray garbled character. These are fixes for displaying only part of a string without distorting what remains.
body.ja: 内容に合わせて幅を決める overlay（主画面に重なる小さなパネル）は、文字が切り詰められても一列広く描画しなくなった。先頭を切り詰めた文字も省略記号だけにならない。長い shell command（シェルコマンド）のプレビューで文字化けが起きなくなった。agent description（エージェント説明）のプレビューも同様である。emoji（絵文字）の途中で切れても、余計な文字化けを残さない。
body.ko: 내용에 따라 너비를 정하는 overlay(주 화면 위에 겹치는 작은 패널)는 글자가 잘려도 한 열 넓게 그리지 않는다. 앞부분이 잘린 글자도 줄임표만 남지 않는다. 긴 shell command(셸 명령)의 미리보기가 잘려도 문제없다. agent description(에이전트 설명)의 미리보기도 마찬가지다. emoji(이모지) 중간에서 잘려도 깨진 글자를 남기지 않는다。

items.original:
Fixed content-sized overlays containing truncated text rendering one column too wide, and start-truncated text collapsing to an ellipsis
Fixed a stray garbled character where a long shell-command or agent-description preview was cut off mid-emoji

title.zh-TW: 外掛市集同時寫入時，不會被意外取消登記
title.zh-CN: 插件市场同时写入时，不会被意外取消登记
title.en: A plugin marketplace no longer disappears during simultaneous startup writes
title.ja: 起動時の同時書き込みでプラグイン市場が消えなくなった
title.ko: 시작 중 동시 쓰기로 플러그인 마켓이 사라지지 않는다

body.zh-TW: 剛啟動 Claude Code 時，若多個工作同時寫入 `known_marketplaces.json`，原本有一個競爭時機，可能悄悄把已登記的外掛市集取消登記。現在這個 startup race（啟動時的競爭狀況）已修好，市集不會因為同時寫檔而消失。你不必看到外掛來源忽然不見，卻找不到錯誤訊息。這如同幾位店員同時更新同一本供應商名冊時，現在不會有人把另一人剛寫好的店名抹掉。
body.zh-CN: 刚启动 Claude Code 时，若多个工作同时写入 `known_marketplaces.json`，原本存在竞争时机，可能悄悄取消已登记的插件市场。现在这个 startup race（启动时的竞争状况）已修好，市场不会因同时写文件而消失。像几位店员同时更新同一本供应商名册时，不会有人抹掉另一人刚写好的店名。
body.en: A startup race caused by concurrent writes to `known_marketplaces.json` could silently unregister a plugin marketplace. That race is fixed, so a registered marketplace no longer disappears when startup work writes the file at the same time.
body.ja: Claude Code の起動時、複数の処理が `known_marketplaces.json` へ同時に書き込む startup race（起動時の競合）により、登録済みプラグイン市場が黙って登録解除されることがあった。修正により、同時書き込みで市場が消えなくなった。複数の店員が同じ仕入先名簿を更新しても、他人が書いた店名を消さないようなものだ。
body.ko: Claude Code 시작 때 여러 작업이 `known_marketplaces.json`에 동시에 쓰면서 생기는 startup race(시작 시 경쟁 상태)로 등록된 플러그인 마켓이 조용히 등록 해제될 수 있었다. 이제 동시 쓰기로 마켓이 사라지지 않는다. 여러 점원이 같은 공급처 명부를 고쳐도 다른 사람이 쓴 가게 이름을 지우지 않는 셈이다。

items.original: Fixed a startup race that could silently unregister a plugin marketplace due to concurrent writes to `known_marketplaces.json`

title.zh-TW: 可繼續的工作在跑，更新介面也能重啟
title.zh-CN: 可继续的工作在跑，更新界面也能重启
title.en: Update and TUI can restart while surviving work is running
title.ja: 継続する作業が動作中でも Update と TUI を再起動できる
title.ko: 계속 살아 있는 작업이 돌아가도 Update와 TUI를 다시 시작한다

body.zh-TW: 你要執行 `/update` 或 `/tui`，同時又有重啟後仍會存活的工作正在跑，先前這兩個指令可能拒絕重啟。現在它們不會因為那類工作還在運作就擋住。這不是把工作中止，而是承認它能跨過重新啟動繼續存在，讓更新或文字介面能照常重新開始。像一棟大樓有獨立供電的設備仍在運轉時，管理員可以重開大廳的顯示面板，不必把整棟樓的工作都先關掉。
body.zh-CN: 你要执行 `/update` 或 `/tui`，同时又有重启后仍会存活的工作在跑，之前这两个命令可能拒绝重启。现在它们不会因这类工作仍在运行就拦住。这不是中止工作，而是让更新或文字界面照常重新开始。像有独立供电设备仍在运行时，管理员可重开大厅显示面板。
body.en: `/update` and `/tui` no longer refuse to restart just because work that survives the relaunch is running. That work is not being stopped; the update or text interface can restart while it continues to survive the relaunch.
body.ja: 再起動後も存続する作業が動いていると、以前は `/update` と `/tui` が再起動を拒否することがあった。今はその作業を止めずに、更新または文字インターフェースを再起動できる。独立電源の設備を動かしたまま、ロビーの表示板だけを再起動するようなものだ。
body.ko: 다시 시작해도 살아남는 작업이 실행 중이면 예전에는 `/update`와 `/tui`가 재시작을 거부할 수 있었다. 이제 그 작업을 멈추지 않고 업데이트나 텍스트 인터페이스를 다시 시작한다. 독립 전원 장비를 켠 채 로비 표시판만 다시 켜는 셈이다。

items.original: Fixed `/update` and `/tui` refusing to restart while work that survives the relaunch was running

title.zh-TW: 額度用完時，只推薦目前真的能用的指令
title.zh-CN: 额度用完时，只推荐当前真的能用的命令
title.en: Usage-limit guidance now recommends only available slash commands
title.ja: 利用上限の案内が使えるスラッシュコマンドだけを勧める
title.ko: 사용 한도 안내가 실제 쓸 수 있는 슬래시 명령만 권한다

body.zh-TW: 在 SDK 或遠端工作階段遇到 usage limit（使用額度上限）時，Claude 的說明以前可能建議你一個該環境根本沒有的 slash command，以 `/` 開頭的指令，。現在建議會避開不可用指令。這項修正不改變你的額度，也不憑空增加指令；它只讓卡住時的說明符合你手邊能操作的介面。像車站告示不再指你去一個已封閉的月台，而是只指向目前能走的出口。
body.zh-CN: 在 SDK 或远程会话遇到 usage limit（使用额度上限）时，Claude 的说明以前可能建议该环境根本没有的 slash command，以 `/` 开头的命令，。现在会避开不可用命令。这不改变额度，也不凭空增加命令，只让卡住时的说明符合当前界面。像车站告示不再指你去已封闭的站台。
body.en: In SDK and remote sessions, usage-limit guidance no longer suggests slash commands that are unavailable in that environment. It does not change the limit or add commands; it makes the guidance point only to actions that the current session can actually use.
body.ja: SDK またはリモートセッションで usage limit（利用枠上限）に達することがある。その際、以前の案内はその環境では使えない slash command（`/` で始まるコマンド）を勧めることがあった。今は利用不能なコマンドを勧めない。上限を変えるのではなく、現在の画面で実行できる操作だけを案内する。
body.ko: SDK나 원격 세션에서 usage limit(사용 한도 상한)에 닿을 때가 있다. 그때 예전 안내는 그 환경에 없는 slash command(`/`로 시작하는 명령)를 권할 수 있었다. 이제 쓸 수 없는 명령은 권하지 않는다. 한도를 바꾸는 것이 아니라 현재 세션에서 실제 실행할 수 있는 행동만 가리킨다。

items.original: Fixed usage-limit guidance suggesting unavailable slash commands in SDK and remote sessions

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制不再帶走雲端工作階段的內容與憑證
title.zh-CN: 远程控制不再带走云端会话的内容与凭证
title.en: Remote Control no longer inherits a cloud session’s transcript or credentials
title.ja: リモートコントロールがクラウドセッションの履歴や認証情報を引き継がない
title.ko: 원격 제어가 클라우드 세션의 기록이나 자격 증명을 물려받지 않는다

body.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段裡的 bridge（連接兩端的橋接程式）若主持 Remote Control，遠端控制，把本機工作階段接到另一端使用，，以前遠端控制工作階段可能繼承那個雲端工作階段的 transcript，對話逐字紀錄，或 credentials，登入身分證明，。現在這份繼承關係已移除。遠端控制還是能由橋接程式主持，但不會把主持它的雲端工作階段內容或登入證明一起帶進去。這像在共享會議室接通投影設備，不會順便把上一場會議的筆記和門禁卡交給下一位使用者。
body.zh-CN: 云端会话里的 bridge（连接两端的桥接程序）若主持 Remote Control，远程控制，把本机会话接到另一端使用，，以前远程控制会话可能继承云端会话的 transcript，对话逐字记录，或 credentials，登录身份证明，。现在这层继承已移除。远程控制仍可由桥接程序主持，但不会带入主持它的云端会话内容或登录证明。
body.en: A Remote Control session hosted by a bridge inside a cloud session no longer inherits that cloud session’s transcript or credentials. The bridge can still host Remote Control, but the hosted session does not receive the cloud session’s conversation record or login proof.
body.ja: クラウドセッション内の bridge（両端をつなぐ中継プログラム）が仲介役を務める場合がある。ここで Remote Control（リモートコントロール、ローカルセッションを別の場所から使う機能）をホストしても、クラウド側の情報を引き継がない。そのクラウドセッションの transcript（会話の逐語記録）は渡されない。同様に credentials（ログインの身元証明）も引き継がなくなった。橋がホストしても、内容や証明までは渡らない。
body.ko: 클라우드 세션 안의 bridge(양쪽을 잇는 중계 프로그램)가 중계를 맡을 때가 있다. 여기서 Remote Control(원격 제어, 로컬 세션을 다른 곳에서 쓰는 기능)을 호스팅해도 클라우드 쪽 정보를 물려받지 않는다. 해당 클라우드 세션의 transcript(대화 기록)는 넘어가지 않는다. 마찬가지로 credentials(로그인 신원 증명)도 이어받지 않게 되었다. bridge는 계속 호스팅하지만 내용과 증명은 건네지 않는다。

items.original: Fixed Remote Control sessions hosted by a bridge inside a cloud session inheriting that session's transcript or credentials

title.zh-TW: 長對話串流與貼圖，不再堵住畫面反應
title.zh-CN: 长对话流式输出与贴图，不再堵住界面响应
title.en: Long streaming and pasted images no longer block responsiveness
title.ja: 長いストリーミングと貼り付け画像が応答性を塞がない
title.ko: 긴 스트리밍과 붙여넣은 이미지가 반응성을 막지 않는다

body.zh-TW: 全螢幕看著長對話持續更新時，畫面現在能維持回應，因為每次更新不再把整段對話重新 normalise（整理成一致格式）。貼上或從剪貼簿讀取 image（圖片）時，也不再阻塞 event loop，負責依序處理畫面與輸入事件的主迴圈，。兩項改動都在避免一件正在進來的內容，堵住其他操作。像書記收到新紙張時，不再每次都把整疊文件重整一次；同事遞來一張照片，也不必讓接待櫃台停擺才能收下。
body.zh-CN: 全屏看长对话持续更新时，界面现在能保持响应，因为每次更新不再把整段对话重新 normalise（整理成一致格式）。粘贴或从剪贴板读取 image（图片）时，也不再阻塞 event loop，依次处理界面与输入事件的主循环，。两项都避免正在进入的内容堵住其他操作。
body.en: Fullscreen streaming stays responsive in long sessions because each update no longer re-normalizes the whole conversation. Pasted and clipboard images are read without blocking the event loop, the main loop that processes interface and input events. Incoming content no longer has to stop the rest of the interface to be handled.
body.ja: 全画面で長い会話をストリーミングしても、更新のたびに会話全体を normalise（一貫した形式に整えること）し直さないため応答性を保つ。貼り付けた image（画像）やクリップボード画像の読み取りも非同期で行われる。これにより、event loop（画面と入力イベントを順に処理する主ループ）を塞がない。入ってくる内容がほかの操作を止めないようにする変更である。
body.ko: 전체 화면에서 긴 대화를 스트리밍해도 업데이트마다 전체 대화를 normalise(일관된 형식으로 정리하는 일)하지 않아 반응성을 유지한다. 붙여넣거나 클립보드에서 image(이미지)를 읽는 동작도 개선되었다. 이제 event loop(화면과 입력 이벤트를 순서대로 처리하는 주 반복)를 막지 않는다. 들어오는 내용이 다른 조작을 멈추게 하지 않는다。

items.original:
Improved fullscreen streaming: long sessions stay responsive because the whole conversation is no longer re-normalized on every update
Pasted and clipboard images are read without blocking the event loop

title.zh-TW: 受管理設定的核准視窗，標出來源也分清風險
title.zh-CN: 托管设置的批准窗口，标出来源也分清风险
title.en: Managed-settings approval shows endpoints and separates higher-risk overrides
title.ja: 管理設定の承認画面が接続先を示し、高リスクな上書きを区別する
title.ko: 관리 설정 승인 창이 연결 지점을 보이고 위험한 덮어쓰기를 구분한다

body.zh-TW: 看到受管理設定的核准對話框時，現在可先看到 endpoint URL（服務連線網址），也會用更清楚的文字說明只改 telemetry，遙測資料，時的意義。一般的 OpenTelemetry 選項不再每次都要求核准，但伺服器管理的 sandbox binary override（替換隔離區使用程式的設定）仍會要求同意，包含 `sandbox.bwrapPath`、`sandbox.socatPath`、`sandbox.ripgrep`。這不是把所有設定放行，而是把例行資料選項和會換掉隔離區工具的設定分開。像簽收單略過普通的聯絡欄更新，卻在有人要更換保險箱鑰匙時，清楚列出地址並請你簽名。
body.zh-CN: 看到托管设置的批准对话框时，现在可先看到 endpoint URL（服务连接网址），也会用更清楚的文字说明只改 telemetry，遥测数据，时的意义。常规 OpenTelemetry 选项不再每次都要求批准，但服务器管理的 sandbox binary override（替换隔离区所用程序的设置）仍需同意，包含 `sandbox.bwrapPath`、`sandbox.socatPath`、`sandbox.ripgrep`。它将例行数据选项和替换隔离工具的设置分开。
body.en: The managed-settings approval dialog now shows endpoint URLs and explains telemetry-only changes more clearly. Routine OpenTelemetry options are skipped, while server-managed sandbox binary overrides still need approval: `sandbox.bwrapPath`, `sandbox.socatPath`, and `sandbox.ripgrep`. It distinguishes routine telemetry settings from changes that replace a sandbox tool.
body.ja: 管理設定の承認ダイアログは endpoint URL（サービス接続先 URL）を表示する。また、telemetry（遠隔計測データ）のみの変更を分かりやすく説明する。通常の OpenTelemetry 選択肢は承認を省くが、サーバー管理の sandbox binary override（隔離領域で使うプログラムを差し替える設定）は承認が必要で、`sandbox.bwrapPath`、`sandbox.socatPath`、`sandbox.ripgrep` が対象である。
body.ko: 관리 설정 승인 대화창은 endpoint URL(서비스 연결 주소)을 보여 준다. 또한 telemetry(원격 측정 데이터)만 바꾸는 일을 더 분명히 설명한다. 일반 OpenTelemetry 선택지는 건너뛰지만 서버 관리 sandbox binary override(격리 영역에 쓰는 프로그램을 바꾸는 설정)는 `sandbox.bwrapPath`, `sandbox.socatPath`, `sandbox.ripgrep`을 포함해 승인받는다。

items.original: Improved the managed settings approval dialog: shows endpoint URLs, uses clearer wording for telemetry-only changes, skips routine OpenTelemetry options, and requires approval for server-managed sandbox binary overrides (`sandbox.bwrapPath`, `sandbox.socatPath`, `sandbox.ripgrep`)

title.zh-TW: 回報與程式審查，不必等眼前回覆結束
title.zh-CN: 反馈与代码审查，不必等当前回复结束
title.en: Feedback, bug reports, and higher-effort code review no longer hold up the turn
title.ja: フィードバック、バグ報告、高い作業量のコード審査が応答完了を待たない
title.ko: 피드백, 버그 신고, 높은 작업량 코드 검토가 응답 종료를 기다리지 않는다

body.zh-TW: Claude 還在回覆時，你現在可立刻開啟 `/feedback` 或 `/bug`，不用等這一輪結束。`/code-review` 選 high、xhigh、max effort（投入較多推理工作的層級）時，也和其他層級一樣改在背景代理執行。前者讓你在想到問題的當下就能開回報入口，後者讓較高工作量的審查不佔住互動對話。像演講還沒結束時，你能先拿到意見卡；需要較久的審稿則交給旁邊的助理處理，講台仍可繼續使用。
body.zh-CN: Claude 还在回复时，你现在可立刻打开 `/feedback` 或 `/bug`，不用等这轮结束。`/code-review` 选 high、xhigh、max effort（投入更多推理工作的层级）时，也像其他层级一样在后台代理运行。前者让你想到问题就能打开反馈入口，后者不占住交互对话。
body.en: `/feedback` and `/bug` now open immediately even while Claude is responding. `/code-review` at high, xhigh, and max effort now runs in a background agent like other effort levels. One action opens the reporting form without waiting; the other moves the longer review work off the interactive conversation.
body.ja: Claude が応答中でも `/feedback` と `/bug` はすぐ開く。`/code-review` の high、xhigh、max effort（より多くの推論作業を使う段階）も、ほかの段階と同様にバックグラウンドエージェントで動く。報告は応答完了を待たずに始められ、時間のかかる審査は対話を占有しない。
body.ko: Claude가 응답 중이어도 `/feedback`과 `/bug`가 바로 열린다. `/code-review`의 high, xhigh, max effort(더 많은 추론 작업을 쓰는 단계)도 다른 단계처럼 백그라운드 에이전트에서 실행한다. 신고는 답변 끝을 기다리지 않고 시작하고 긴 검토는 대화를 차지하지 않는다。

items.original:
`/feedback` and `/bug` now open immediately when invoked while Claude is responding, instead of waiting for the turn to finish
`/code-review` at high, xhigh, and max effort now runs in a background agent like the other levels

title.zh-TW: 代理完成後更好收納，不再催你建立自訂代理
title.zh-CN: 代理完成后更好收纳，不再催你创建自定义代理
title.en: Finished agents are tidier and custom-agent nudges are gone
title.ja: 完了したエージェントが整理され、カスタム作成の催促が消えた
title.ko: 끝난 에이전트가 정리되고 사용자 지정 생성 권유가 사라졌다

body.zh-TW: 背景代理完成後，agent panel（顯示代理工作的面板）會立刻把它隱藏，底部留下 `/tasks` 提示；「↓ N more」溢出指示也移到左邊，較容易看見。恢復已完成背景代理的訊息改短。啟動時建議建立自訂子代理的提示，以及 `/powerup` 導覽裡相同的催促，也一併移除。這些不改代理怎麼做事，而是整理它完成後留下的資訊與干擾。像待辦牆把完成紙條收進抽屜、把剩餘數量貼到看得見處，也不再每次經過都催你另開一本待辦簿。
body.zh-CN: 背景代理完成后，agent panel（显示代理工作的面板）会立刻将其隐藏，底部留下 `/tasks` 提示；“↓ N more”溢出指示移到左边，更容易看见。恢复已完成背景代理的消息也变短。启动时建议创建自定义子代理的提示，以及 `/powerup` 导览里的相同催促一并移除。它整理的是完成后的信息，不改变代理如何工作。
body.en: Completed background subagents now hide immediately in the agent panel with a `/tasks` footer hint, and “↓ N more” moved left. The resume message for a completed background agent is shorter. The startup tip about creating custom subagents and the matching `/powerup` nudge are removed. These changes tidy status information rather than change how agents work.
body.ja: 完了したバックグラウンド子エージェントは agent panel（エージェント作業を示すパネル）からすぐ隠れ、下部に `/tasks` の案内が残る。「↓ N more」は左へ移った。完了済み背景エージェントを再開する際のメッセージも短くなった。カスタム子エージェント作成を勧める起動時の案内と `/powerup` の同じ促しは削除された。
body.ko: 끝난 백그라운드 하위 에이전트는 agent panel(에이전트 작업을 보이는 패널)에서 바로 숨고 아래에 `/tasks` 힌트가 남는다. “↓ N more”는 왼쪽으로 옮겼다. 완료한 백그라운드 에이전트를 다시 열 때 메시지도 짧아졌다. 사용자 지정 하위 에이전트를 만들라는 시작 팁과 `/powerup`의 같은 권유도 사라졌다。

items.original:
Updated agent panel: completed subagents hide immediately with a `/tasks` footer hint, and the "↓ N more" overflow indicator moved left for visibility
Shortened the message shown when resuming a completed background agent
Removed the startup tip suggesting you create custom subagents, and the matching nudge in the `/powerup` tour

title.zh-TW: Cowork 不再把外部記憶匯入直接塞進對話
title.zh-CN: Cowork 不再把外部记忆导入直接塞进对话
title.en: Cowork stops inlining external imports from user memory
title.ja: Cowork が外部メモリ import を本文へ展開しない
title.ko: Cowork가 외부 메모리 가져오기를 본문에 넣지 않는다

body.zh-TW: Cowork 工作階段讀取使用者範圍的 memory file（記憶檔）時，外部 `@`-import，用 `@` 引入另一份內容，不再直接 inline，展開後塞入目前內容，。這項改動限定在外部匯入與使用者範圍記憶檔的組合，不是說 Cowork 不再讀取記憶檔本身。它避免一份記憶檔引用的外部內容自動混進目前工作階段。像你借閱一本索引冊時，現在只看到索引指向哪裡，不會把它引用的每本外部書都倒進桌上。
body.zh-CN: Cowork 会话读取用户范围的 memory file（记忆文件）时，外部 `@`-import，用 `@` 引入另一份内容，不再直接 inline，展开后塞入当前内容，。这限定在外部导入与用户范围记忆文件的组合，不是 Cowork 不再读记忆文件。它避免被引用的外部内容自动混入当前会话。
body.en: Cowork sessions no longer inline external `@`-imports from user-scope memory files. This is about external imports being expanded into the current session, not about Cowork ceasing to read the memory file itself. Referenced external content no longer automatically enters the session through that route.
body.ja: Cowork セッションは、ユーザー範囲の memory file（記憶ファイル）を扱う。そこからの外部 `@`-import（`@` で別内容を読み込むこと）の動作が変更された。外部の内容をそのまま inline（展開して現在の内容へ入れること）しなくなった。memory file 自体を読まなくなるという意味ではない。参照先の外部内容が、その経路で自動的にセッションへ混ざらない。
body.ko: Cowork 세션은 사용자 범위 memory file(메모리 파일)을 다룬다. 여기서 외부 `@`-import(`@`로 다른 내용을 불러오는 일) 동작이 바뀌었다. 외부 내용을 그대로 inline(펼쳐서 현재 내용에 넣는 일)하지 않는다. memory file 자체를 읽지 않는다는 뜻은 아니다. 참조한 외부 내용이 그 경로로 세션에 자동으로 섞이지 않는다。

items.original: Cowork sessions no longer inline external @-imports from user-scope memory files

title.zh-TW: 沙盒只信指定來源，跨工作階段插槽也拒絕假路徑
title.zh-CN: 沙盒只信指定来源，跨会话插槽也拒绝假路径
title.en: Sandbox paths trust only approved sources and reject planted directories
title.ja: サンドボックスは許可済みの設定元だけを信頼し、仕込まれた場所を拒否する
title.ko: 샌드박스는 허용된 설정 출처만 믿고 심어진 경로를 거부한다

body.zh-TW: 共用 `/tmp` 裡自動建立的跨工作階段訊息 socket directory（插槽資料夾，讓程式彼此傳訊的位置），若遇到預先放好的 symlink，符號連結，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔，或其他使用者的資料夾，現在會拒絕使用。Linux filesystem sandbox（限制程式可碰檔案範圍的隔離區）也補上受保護路徑的繞過防護。`sandbox.ripgrep` 則只接受 user、managed、`--settings` 設定來源，project settings 不再能覆寫沙盒所用的 ripgrep。三項都在收緊檔案與工具的來源邊界。
body.zh-CN: 共享 `/tmp` 里自动创建的跨会话消息 socket directory（插槽文件夹，让程序互相传话的位置），若遇到预先放好的 symlink，符号链接，指向另一位置的快捷文件，或其他用户的文件夹，现在会拒绝使用。Linux filesystem sandbox（限制程序可接触文件范围的隔离区）也补上受保护路径绕过防护。`sandbox.ripgrep` 只接受 user、managed、`--settings` 设置来源，project settings 不能再覆写沙盒所用的 ripgrep。
body.en: The auto-generated cross-session messaging socket directory in shared `/tmp` now refuses a planted symlink or another user’s directory. The Linux filesystem sandbox is hardened against a protected-path bypass. `sandbox.ripgrep` is honored only from user, managed, and `--settings` settings; project settings cannot override the sandbox’s ripgrep binary.
body.ja: 共有 `/tmp` にはクロスセッション通信用の socket directory（プログラム同士が送受信する場所）が自動生成される。これは仕込まれた symlink（別の場所を指すショートカットファイル）または他ユーザーのディレクトリを拒否する。Linux filesystem sandbox（プログラムが触れるファイル範囲を制限する隔離領域）も保護パスの迂回を防ぐ。`sandbox.ripgrep` は user、managed、`--settings` 設定からのみ有効で、project settings はサンドボックスの ripgrep を上書きできない。
body.ko: 공유 `/tmp`에는 교차 세션 메시지용 socket directory(프로그램끼리 메시지를 주고받는 위치)가 자동 생성된다. 이곳은 미리 심은 symlink(다른 위치를 가리키는 바로 가기 파일)나 다른 사용자의 디렉터리를 거부한다. Linux filesystem sandbox(프로그램이 닿는 파일 범위를 제한하는 격리 영역)도 보호 경로 우회를 막는다. `sandbox.ripgrep`는 user, managed, `--settings` 설정에서만 인정하며 project settings는 샌드박스의 ripgrep을 덮지 못한다。

items.original:
Hardened the auto-generated cross-session messaging socket directory on shared `/tmp`: a pre-planted symlink or another user's directory is now refused instead of used
Hardened the Linux filesystem sandbox against a protected-path bypass
Changed `sandbox.ripgrep` to be honored only from user, managed, and `--settings` settings; project settings can no longer override the sandbox's ripgrep binary

entries: Fixed MCP OAuth sign-in failing with a redirect URI mismatch for servers that use a pre-registered OAuth client, such as Slack

title.zh-TW: Slack 的 MCP 登入不再卡在網址不合
title.zh-CN: Slack 的 MCP 登录不再卡在网址不匹配
title.en: MCP sign-in to Slack no longer stops at a mismatched URL
title.ja: Slack の MCP ログインが URL の不一致で止まらなくなった
title.ko: Slack MCP 로그인이 URL 불일치로 멈추지 않는다

body.zh-TW: 你想把 Slack 接進 Claude，卻在登入畫面繞了一圈又回到錯誤訊息，問題可能不在你的帳號。MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）登入時，伺服器會比對回傳網址。有些服務會使用預先登記好的 OAuth client（用來核對身分的登入設定），原本的網址比對卻對不上。現在這種 redirect URI mismatch（回傳網址不一致）已修好，包含 Slack 這類伺服器。像寄件人與收件人地址其實一致，分揀台以前卻誤判格式不同而退件；現在能把信送回正確入口。
body.zh-CN: 你想把 Slack 接进 Claude，却在登录画面绕了一圈又回到错误信息，问题可能不在你的账号。MCP（Model Context Protocol，让 AI 连接外部工具的协议）登录时，服务器会比对返回网址。有些服务会使用预先登记好的 OAuth client（用来核对身份的登录设置），原本的网址比对却对不上。现在这种 redirect URI mismatch（返回网址不一致）已修好，包含 Slack 这类服务器。就像寄件人和收件人地址其实一致，分拣台以前却误判格式不同而退件；现在能把信送回正确入口。
body.en: If you tried to connect Slack to Claude and were sent from sign-in straight back to an error, your account may not have been the problem. During MCP (Model Context Protocol, the protocol that connects AI to external tools) sign-in, the server compares the return URL. Some servers, including Slack, use a pre-registered OAuth client, and that comparison could fail. The redirect URI mismatch is now fixed. It was like a mail sorter rejecting a letter whose address was right but written in a format it did not expect; it can now send the letter to the proper entrance.
body.ja: Slack を Claude につなごうとしてログイン画面を一周し、またエラーに戻ったなら、アカウントが原因とは限らない。MCP（Model Context Protocol、AI を外部ツールへ接続するための協定）のログインでは、サーバーが戻り先 URL を照合する。Slack のように OAuth client（OAuth で本人確認に使うログイン設定）を事前登録したサーバーでは、その照合が合わないことがあった。redirect URI mismatch（戻り先 URL の不一致）は修正された。宛先は合っているのに書式だけで仕分け機が返送していた手紙を、正しい入口へ届けられるようになったようなものだ。
body.ko: Slack을 Claude에 연결하려는데 로그인 화면을 한 바퀴 돈 뒤 다시 오류가 나왔다면 계정 탓만은 아닐 수 있다. MCP(Model Context Protocol, AI를 외부 도구에 연결하는 규약) 로그인에서는 서버가 돌아갈 URL을 대조한다. Slack처럼 OAuth client(OAuth에서 신원을 확인하는 로그인 설정)를 미리 등록한 서버는 이 대조가 맞지 않을 때가 있었다. 이제 redirect URI mismatch(돌아갈 URL 불일치)가 고쳐졌다. 주소는 맞는데 표기 형식이 다르다고 분류기가 반송하던 편지를 올바른 입구로 보내는 것과 같다.

items.original: Fixed MCP OAuth sign-in failing with a redirect URI mismatch for servers that use a pre-registered OAuth client, such as Slack

entries: Documented `claude remote-control --continue` for resuming the most recent Remote Control session
Added server-supplied Claude Code hook support for self-hosted runner sessions, matching managed-environment behavior
Added SSE keepalive pings to gateway streaming responses during long thinking pauses, preventing idle-timeout disconnects on Vertex and Bedrock upstreams
Added plugin marketplace `command` sources: a local command (e.g. an IDE) prints the plugin directory, which is re-resolved each session and applied without a restart; `mode: "link"` uses it in place
`ListAgents` now marks disconnected Remote Control sessions as `offline` and labels your cloud sessions as `cloud`
Fixed long responses partly disappearing while streaming and being printed twice in the terminal
Fixed a crash to the error screen (including on `--resume` of the affected session) when a tool call had a non-string `glob`, `file_path`, or `command` value
Fixed a RangeError crash when a progress bar or markdown table rendered in a very narrow terminal window (could also crash `claude --continue`/`--resume` at startup)
Fixed a crash on Windows when a tool call or message referenced a file by an extended-length (`\\?\`) or UNC path
Fixed auto mode failing on every tool call for users who disable the attribution header via `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER` (direct Anthropic API connections)
Fixed `/model` rejecting Sonnet/Opus 1M for claude.ai subscribers using a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateway
Fixed MCP OAuth with strict authorization servers by using `127.0.0.1` instead of `localhost` in the redirect URI
Fixed Remote Control clients showing a stuck working spinner after a slash command typed in the laptop terminal
Fixed the Claude Code Review workflow generated by `/install-github-app` completing without posting its review on the pull request
Fixed multi-second UI stalls after editing a file with thousands of IDE diagnostics while the IDE extension is connected
Fixed one-shot `claude plugin` commands leaving a stray liveness file that could prevent cleanup of outdated plugin versions
Fixed dynamic workflows inside CPU-limited containers using the host machine's core count instead of the container's CPU limit
Fixed a file-watcher handle leak after atomic file replacements, and an uncaught error on Windows when the scheduled-tasks watcher failed on a network or virtual filesystem
Fixed SDK and `--input-format stream-json` sessions getting a 400 API error when a whitespace-only message was submitted
Fixed conversations whose messages alone exceed the API's 32 MB request limit retrying compaction when no images or documents can be stripped; they now fail once with a clear message
Fixed OpenTelemetry export from Claude Desktop sessions being rejected by the Desktop-managed gateway when that gateway is also the telemetry endpoint
Fixed self-hosted runner and other remote sessions exiting at startup when `managed-mcp.json` is deployed and the server delivers MCP servers; those servers are now skipped with a warning
Fixed self-hosted runner repository preparation hanging on a Git Credential Manager prompt; git now fails fast when credentials are missing
Improved workflow fan-outs to stagger same-prefix sibling agents so subsequent agents read the cached prompt prefix instead of re-paying it (`CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_PREFIX_STAGGER_MS=0` disables)
Improved "prompt is too long" errors to explain why automatic compaction could not recover instead of only suggesting `/compact`
Improved sandbox: IPv6 literals in network domain lists are now bracketed (`[::1]:443`), and ambiguous spellings are enforced fail-closed and flagged by `/doctor`
Updated `/login` to repeat the `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` override warning after a successful login
Changed `/commit-push-pr` so git/gh commands with dangerous flags (`--force`, `--amend`, `--no-verify`, etc.) are no longer auto-approved
Changed self-hosted runner Windows startup to require an explicit `--base-dir`; there is no default checkout directory on Windows
[VSCode] "Report a problem" and `/bug` now open the built-in feedback dialog instead of a retired survey link
[VSCode] Made the `/btw` side-question panel resizable by dragging its boundary, in both side-docked and stacked layouts
[VSCode] Added session groups in the sidebar — right-click to create, rename, or delete; Cmd/Ctrl- or Shift-click to move several sessions at once

title.zh-TW: 遠端工作階段斷線不再假裝還在忙
title.zh-CN: 远程会话断线不再假装还在忙
title.en: Remote sessions stop pretending they are still working
title.ja: リモートセッションが切断後も作業中のふりをしなくなった
title.ko: 원격 세션이 끊긴 뒤에도 작업 중인 척하지 않는다

body.zh-TW: 你離開電腦後用 Remote Control 遠端控制，回來想接著做，現在可用 `claude remote-control --continue` 接回最近一次工作階段。ListAgents 也會把斷線的工作階段標成 `offline`，雲端的標成 `cloud`；筆電終端機輸入斜線指令後，遠端畫面不會再一直轉圈。像車站看板終於分清楚列車是在月台、已離站，還是根本不在線上，不必盯著假進度猜它在做什麼。
body.zh-CN: 离开电脑后用 Remote Control 远程控制，回来想接着做，现在可用 `claude remote-control --continue` 接回最近一次会话。ListAgents 也会把断线会话标成 `offline`，云端的标成 `cloud`；笔记本终端输入斜杠命令后，远程画面不会再一直转圈。像车站看板终于分清列车是在站台、已离站，还是根本不在线上，不必盯着假进度猜它在做什么。
body.en: When you return to a Remote Control job, `claude remote-control --continue` resumes your latest session. ListAgents now calls disconnected sessions `offline` and cloud sessions `cloud`; a slash command typed in your laptop terminal no longer leaves the remote client spinning forever. It is like a station board that finally distinguishes a train at the platform, one that has departed, and one that is not on the network at all.
body.ja: Remote Control で席を離れた作業へ戻るなら、`claude remote-control --continue` で直近のセッションを再開できる。ListAgents は切断済みを `offline`、クラウド上を `cloud` と表示し、ノート PC の端末でスラッシュコマンドを打った後に遠隔画面だけが回り続けることもなくなった。駅の案内板が列車の所在を正しく示すようなものだ。
body.ko: Remote Control 작업으로 돌아올 때 `claude remote-control --continue`를 쓰면 가장 최근 세션을 이어 갈 수 있다. ListAgents는 끊긴 세션을 `offline`, 클라우드 세션을 `cloud`로 표시하며, 노트북 터미널에서 슬래시 명령을 친 뒤 원격 화면의 회전 표시가 멈추지 않던 문제도 고쳤다. 역 안내판이 열차 위치를 제대로 알려 주는 것과 같다。

items.original:
Documented `claude remote-control --continue` for resuming the most recent Remote Control session
`ListAgents` now marks disconnected Remote Control sessions as `offline` and labels your cloud sessions as `cloud`
Fixed Remote Control clients showing a stuck working spinner after a slash command typed in the laptop terminal

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器開工時少踩三種地雷
title.zh-CN: 自建执行器开工时少踩三种地雷
title.en: Self-hosted runners hit fewer traps at startup
title.ja: セルフホストランナーの起動時の落とし穴が減った
title.ko: 자체 호스팅 러너가 시작할 때 밟는 함정이 줄었다

body.zh-TW: 公司自己架的 runner（執行器，替遠端工作接手跑任務的機器）現在比較能順利開工。伺服器可提供 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），行為會跟受管理環境一致；若 `managed-mcp.json` 和伺服器送來的 MCP 伺服器撞在一起，會略過後者並警告，不會一啟動就退出。缺少 Git 憑證時也不再卡在 Credential Manager 問答；Windows 則必須明寫 `--base-dir`。像施工隊先拿到工地地址、碰到重複工單會標記，沒門禁卡就立刻回報。
body.zh-CN: 公司自己架的 runner（执行器，替远程工作接手跑任务的机器）现在更能顺利开工。服务器可提供 hook（挂钩，特定事件发生时被触发的小程序），行为会跟受管理环境一致；若 `managed-mcp.json` 和服务器送来的 MCP 服务器撞在一起，会跳过后者并警告，不会一启动就退出。缺少 Git 凭证时也不再卡在 Credential Manager 问答；Windows 则必须明写 `--base-dir`。像施工队先拿到工地地址、碰到重复工单会标记，没门禁卡就立刻回报。
body.en: A company-run runner can now start with fewer surprises. Server-supplied hooks, small programs triggered by an event, work like those in managed environments. If `managed-mcp.json` conflicts with MCP servers sent by server, Claude warns and skips those servers instead of exiting. Missing Git credentials fail fast, and Windows now requires an explicit `--base-dir`. Like a work crew that receives its site address, flags duplicate work orders, and reports a missing keycard immediately.
body.ja: 自社運用の runner は起動時につまずきにくくなった。サーバー提供の hook は管理環境と同じように動く。`managed-mcp.json` とサーバー配布の MCP サーバーが衝突した場合は警告して後者を飛ばし、起動直後に終了しない。Git の認証情報がなければすぐ失敗し、Windows では `--base-dir` の明示も必要になった。工事班が住所を受け取り、重複した作業票を印付けし、鍵がなければすぐ報告するようなものである。
body.ko: 회사가 직접 운영하는 runner는 시작할 때 덜 걸린다. 서버가 주는 hook은 특정 사건에서 실행되는 작은 프로그램으로, 관리 환경과 같은 방식으로 동작한다. `managed-mcp.json`과 서버가 보내는 MCP 서버가 충돌하면 경고를 내고 뒤쪽을 건너뛰며 종료하지 않는다. Git 자격 증명이 없으면 빨리 실패하고 Windows에서는 `--base-dir`도 반드시 적어야 한다. 작업반이 공사 주소를 받고 중복 작업표를 표시하며 열쇠가 없으면 곧바로 알리는 모습과 같다。

items.original:
Added server-supplied Claude Code hook support for self-hosted runner sessions, matching managed-environment behavior
Fixed self-hosted runner and other remote sessions exiting at startup when `managed-mcp.json` is deployed and the server delivers MCP servers; those servers are now skipped with a warning
Fixed self-hosted runner repository preparation hanging on a Git Credential Manager prompt; git now fails fast when credentials are missing
Changed self-hosted runner Windows startup to require an explicit `--base-dir`; there is no default checkout directory on Windows

title.zh-TW: 長回覆不中斷，也不會重複說兩遍
title.zh-CN: 长回复不中断，也不会重复说两遍
title.en: Long replies stay connected and do not print twice
title.ja: 長い応答が切れず、二重表示もしなくなった
title.ko: 긴 답변이 끊기지 않고 두 번 출력되지 않는다

body.zh-TW: Claude 想很久才回話時，Vertex 和 Bedrock 的連線不會被上游當成閒置而切斷了。gateway 串流回應會在思考停頓間送出 SSE keepalive ping（保活訊號，告訴對方連線仍活著的短訊息）；同時，長回覆串流時只顯示一次，也不會有一部分憑空消失。像電話兩端沉默思考時偶爾聽到一聲「我還在」，線路就不會被掛掉，說完的話也不會忽然重播或少半句。
body.zh-CN: Claude 想很久才回话时，Vertex 和 Bedrock 的连接不会被上游当成闲置而切断了。gateway 串流响应会在思考停顿间送出 SSE keepalive ping（保活信号，告诉对方连接仍活着的短消息）；同时，长回复串流时只显示一次，也不会有一部分凭空消失。像电话两端沉默思考时偶尔听到一声“我还在”，线路就不会被挂掉，说完的话也不会忽然重播或少半句。
body.en: When Claude pauses to think, Vertex and Bedrock connections are less likely to be cut off as idle. Gateway streams now send SSE keepalive pings, short signals saying connection is alive, during those pauses. Long streamed replies also stop partly disappearing or printing twice. It is like hearing an occasional “I am still here” on a quiet phone call, so line stays open and words do not replay or vanish.
body.ja: Claude が長く考え込む間も、Vertex と Bedrock の接続が上流でアイドル扱いされて切れにくくなった。gateway のストリーミング応答は間に SSE keepalive ping、接続が生きていると伝える短い信号を送る。長い応答の一部が消えたり二度表示されたりする問題も直った。電話で考え込む相手から時々「まだいる」と聞こえ、回線が切れず言葉も重複しないようなものである。
body.ko: Claude가 오래 생각하는 동안 Vertex와 Bedrock 연결이 유휴 상태로 끊기는 일이 줄었다. gateway 스트리밍 응답은 그 사이에 SSE keepalive ping, 연결이 살아 있다고 알리는 짧은 신호를 보낸다. 긴 답변 일부가 사라지거나 두 번 찍히던 문제도 고쳤다. 전화 상대가 생각하는 중에 가끔 “아직 여기 있다”라고 알려 주어 통화가 끊기지 않는 모습과 같다。

items.original:
Added SSE keepalive pings to gateway streaming responses during long thinking pauses, preventing idle-timeout disconnects on Vertex and Bedrock upstreams
Fixed long responses partly disappearing while streaming and being printed twice in the terminal

title.zh-TW: 外掛來源能跟著本機工具更新
title.zh-CN: 插件来源能跟着本机工具更新
title.en: Plugin sources can follow your local tool
title.ja: プラグインの入手先がローカルツールの更新に追随する
title.ko: 플러그인 출처가 로컬 도구 변경을 따라간다

body.zh-TW: 若你的 IDE 要告訴 Claude 外掛放在哪裡，市集現在可把 `command` 設成來源：本機指令印出外掛目錄後，每次工作階段都重新找一次，不必重啟；`mode: "link"` 則直接以那個目錄取代原本內容。單獨跑一次 `claude plugin` 指令後留下的 liveness 檔也會清掉，不再妨礙舊外掛版本清理。像租借櫃的取件地址每次都重新查，搬家後不用重辦會員；用完的號碼牌也不會留在櫃台，堵住後續整理。
body.zh-CN: 若你的 IDE 要告诉 Claude 插件放在哪里，市场现在可把 `command` 设成来源：本机命令打印出插件目录后，每次会话都重新找一次，不必重启；`mode: "link"` 则直接以那个目录取代原本内容。单独跑一次 `claude plugin` 命令后留下的 liveness 文件也会清掉，不再妨碍旧插件版本清理。像租借柜的取件地址每次都重新查，搬家后不用重办会员；用完的号码牌也不会留在柜台，堵住后续整理。
body.en: A plugin marketplace can now use `command` as source: local command, such as an IDE, prints plugin directory, which Claude resolves again for each session without restart. With `mode: "link"`, directory replaces installed content. A one-shot `claude plugin` command also cleans up its leftover liveness file, so old versions can be removed. Like checking locker pickup address each visit rather than filing new membership paperwork after move, then returning used ticket to counter.
body.ja: プラグイン市場は `command` を入手先にできる。IDE などのローカルコマンドが出力するプラグインディレクトリを、再起動せずセッションごとに解決し直す仕組みである。`mode: "link"` ならそのディレクトリを代わりに使う。一回だけの `claude plugin` 実行が残す liveness ファイルも消え、古い版の掃除を妨げない。ロッカーの受取先を毎回確認し、使い終えた整理券を返すようなものだ。
body.ko: 플러그인 마켓은 이제 `command`를 출처로 쓸 수 있다. IDE 같은 로컬 명령이 플러그인 디렉터리를 출력하면 Claude가 매 세션마다 다시 찾으므로 재시작할 필요가 없다. `mode: "link"`에서는 그 디렉터리를 대신 쓴다. 한 번만 실행한 `claude plugin` 명령이 남기는 liveness 파일도 지워져 오래된 버전을 정리할 수 있다. 사물함 수령지를 방문마다 확인하고 쓴 번호표를 돌려주는 것과 같다。

items.original:
Added plugin marketplace `command` sources: a local command (e.g. an IDE) prints the plugin directory, which is re-resolved each session and applied without a restart; `mode: "link"` uses it in place
Fixed one-shot `claude plugin` commands leaving a stray liveness file that could prevent cleanup of outdated plugin versions

title.zh-TW: 狹窄視窗、怪路徑與壞參數不再把程式撞倒
title.zh-CN: 窄窗口、怪路径与坏参数不再把程序撞倒
title.en: Narrow windows, odd paths, and bad arguments stop crashing app
title.ja: 狭い画面、特殊なパス、不正な値で落ちなくなった
title.ko: 좁은 창, 특수 경로, 잘못된 값 때문에 멈추지 않는다

body.zh-TW: 把終端機縮得很窄時，進度列或 Markdown 表格不會再觸發 RangeError，連 `claude --continue`、`--resume` 開機也不會跟著倒下。工具呼叫把本該是文字的 `glob`、`file_path`、`command` 塞成其他型別，程式會避開錯誤畫面；受影響工作階段重新 `--resume` 也一樣。Windows 的 `\\?\` 長路徑與 UNC 網路路徑能處理，原子替換檔案後漏掉的 watcher 控制代號會釋放；排程 watcher 在網路或虛擬檔案系統失敗時不會丟出未接住的錯誤。像窄巷、特殊地址和壞掉的路標都不會讓送貨車翻覆。
body.zh-CN: 把终端缩得很窄时，进度条或 Markdown 表格不会再触发 RangeError，连 `claude --continue`、`--resume` 启动也不会跟着倒下。工具调用把本该是文字的 `glob`、`file_path`、`command` 塞成其他类型，程序会避开错误画面；Windows 的 `\\?\` 长路径与 UNC 网络路径也能处理。原子替换文件后漏掉的 watcher 控制代号会释放，计划 watcher 在网络或虚拟文件系统失败时也不会抛出未接住的错误。像窄巷、特殊地址和坏掉的路标都不会让送货车翻覆。
body.en: Shrinking terminal no longer lets progress bar or Markdown table trigger RangeError, including when `claude --continue` or `--resume` starts. Tool calls with non-text `glob`, `file_path`, or `command` values avoid crash screen, and Windows accepts `\\?\` extended paths and UNC network paths. File-watcher handles after atomic replacements are released; scheduled watcher failures on network or virtual filesystems are caught. Like delivery truck that can pass narrow lanes, strange addresses, and broken signs without overturning.
body.ja: 端末を極端に狭くしても、進捗バーや Markdown 表で RangeError が起きず、`claude --continue` や `--resume` の起動まで巻き込まれない。文字列でない `glob`、`file_path`、`command` が来てもエラー画面に落ちず、Windows の `\\?\` 長いパスや UNC パスも扱える。原子的な置換後に残る watcher のハンドルも解放し、ネットワークや仮想ファイルシステムでの監視失敗も捕捉する。狭い路地や変わった住所で配送車が横転しないようなものである。
body.ko: 터미널 창을 아주 좁게 줄여도 진행 표시줄이나 Markdown 표가 RangeError를 일으키지 않으며 `claude --continue`, `--resume` 시작도 쓰러뜨리지 않는다. 글자가 아닌 `glob`, `file_path`, `command` 값이 와도 오류 화면으로 떨어지지 않고 Windows의 `\\?\` 긴 경로와 UNC 네트워크 경로도 처리한다. 원자적 파일 교체 뒤 남는 watcher 핸들도 풀고 네트워크나 가상 파일 시스템에서 예약 watcher가 실패해도 오류를 놓치지 않는다. 좁은 골목과 이상한 주소가 배달차를 전복시키지 않는 모습과 같다.

items.original:
Fixed a crash to the error screen (including on `--resume` of the affected session) when a tool call had a non-string `glob`, `file_path`, or `command` value
Fixed a RangeError crash when a progress bar or markdown table rendered in a very narrow terminal window (could also crash `claude --continue`/`--resume` at startup)
Fixed a crash on Windows when a tool call or message referenced a file by an extended-length (`\\?\`) or UNC path
Fixed a file-watcher handle leak after atomic file replacements, and an uncaught error on Windows when the scheduled-tasks watcher failed on a network or virtual filesystem

title.zh-TW: 經過閘道連線時，登入與模型選擇更對得上
title.zh-CN: 经过网关连接时，登录与模型选择更对得上
title.en: Login and model choices line up better through gateways
title.ja: ゲートウェイ経由のログインとモデル選択が噛み合う
title.ko: 게이트웨이 연결에서 로그인과 모델 선택이 더 잘 맞는다

body.zh-TW: 你若經由自訂 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 閘道連線，claude.ai 訂閱者現在能在 `/model` 選 Sonnet 或 Opus 1M，不會被錯擋；關掉 attribution header（署名標頭，請求附帶來源標示）後，自動模式每次工具呼叫失敗的問題也修了。嚴格的 MCP OAuth 授權伺服器會收到 `127.0.0.1` 而非 `localhost` 的重新導向網址；Claude Desktop 的 OpenTelemetry（遙測，把使用狀況送到觀測端）若也送往 Desktop 管理的閘道，現在可被接受。像同一棟大樓的訪客證、電梯與收件室終於使用同一套地址格式。
body.zh-CN: 若你经由自定义 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 网关连接，claude.ai 订阅者现在能在 `/model` 选 Sonnet 或 Opus 1M，不会被错挡；关闭 attribution header（署名标头，请求附带来源标示）后，自动模式每次工具调用失败的问题也修了。严格的 MCP OAuth 授权服务器会收到 `127.0.0.1` 而非 `localhost` 的重定向网址；Claude Desktop 的 OpenTelemetry（遥测，把使用状况送到观测端）若也送往 Desktop 管理的网关，现在可被接受。像同一栋大楼的访客证、电梯与收件室终于使用同一套地址格式。
body.en: Through custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateway, claude.ai subscribers can choose Sonnet or Opus 1M in `/model` again. Disabling attribution header, a source label sent with request, no longer makes every auto-mode tool call fail. Strict MCP OAuth servers now receive `127.0.0.1`, not `localhost`, in redirect URI; Claude Desktop telemetry exports are accepted when Desktop-managed gateway is telemetry endpoint too. Like badges, elevator, and mailroom in one building finally using same address format.
body.ja: 独自の `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` ゲートウェイ経由でも、claude.ai 加入者は `/model` で Sonnet や Opus 1M を選べるようになった。attribution header を無効にしても自動モードのツール呼び出しが毎回失敗しない。厳格な MCP OAuth サーバーへの redirect URI は `localhost` でなく `127.0.0.1` になり、Claude Desktop 管理ゲートウェイが送信先でも OpenTelemetry の送信を受け入れる。ビル内の受付証、エレベーター、郵便室が同じ住所表記を使うようなものだ。
body.ko: 사용자 지정 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 게이트웨이를 거쳐도 claude.ai 구독자는 `/model`에서 Sonnet 또는 Opus 1M을 고를 수 있다. 요청의 출처 표기인 attribution header를 꺼도 자동 모드의 모든 도구 호출이 실패하지 않는다. 엄격한 MCP OAuth 서버에는 `localhost` 대신 `127.0.0.1` redirect URI가 전달되고 Claude Desktop 관리 게이트웨이가 원격 측정 대상일 때도 OpenTelemetry 전송이 받아들여진다. 한 건물의 방문증, 엘리베이터, 우편실이 같은 주소 표기를 쓰는 것과 같다。

items.original:
Fixed auto mode failing on every tool call for users who disable the attribution header via `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER` (direct Anthropic API connections)
Fixed `/model` rejecting Sonnet/Opus 1M for claude.ai subscribers using a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateway
Fixed MCP OAuth with strict authorization servers by using `127.0.0.1` instead of `localhost` in the redirect URI
Fixed OpenTelemetry export from Claude Desktop sessions being rejected by the Desktop-managed gateway when that gateway is also the telemetry endpoint

title.zh-TW: GitHub App 裝好的程式碼審查會真的貼出來
title.zh-CN: GitHub App 装好的代码审查会真的贴出来
title.en: GitHub App code reviews now get posted
title.ja: GitHub App で入れたコードレビューが実際に投稿される
title.ko: GitHub App으로 설치한 코드 검토가 실제로 게시된다

body.zh-TW: 你用 `/install-github-app` 裝好 Claude Code Review，等它跑完卻在 Pull Request（合併程式前請人檢查的提案頁）找不到評論，這個落空已修正。工作流程完成時會把審查貼到該 Pull Request，而不是只在背景宣告自己做完。像你請人改一份文件，對方不再把批註鎖在抽屜裡，會把它貼回你正在看的那一頁。
body.zh-CN: 你用 `/install-github-app` 装好 Claude Code Review，等它跑完却在 Pull Request（合并代码前请人检查的提案页）找不到评论，这个落空已修正。工作流完成时会把审查贴到该 Pull Request，而不是只在后台宣告自己做完。像你请人改一份文件，对方不再把批注锁在抽屉里，会把它贴回你正在看的那一页。
